units.leftText: Now in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the river Chebar, the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.
units.rightText: Now it came to pass in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the river Chebar, that the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.
leftNotes: 1:1 The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “אֱלֹהִ֑ים*” (Elohim).

units.leftText: In the fifth of the month, which was the fifth year of King Jehoiachin’s captivity,
units.rightText: In the fifth day of the month, which was the fifth year of king Jehoiachin’s captivity,

units.leftText: the LORD’s word came to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the LORD’s hand was there on him.
units.rightText: the word of Jehovah came expressly unto Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the hand of Jehovah was there upon him.
leftNotes: 1:3 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה*”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

units.leftText: I looked, and behold, a stormy wind came out of the north: a great cloud, with flashing lightning, and a brightness around it, and out of the middle of it as it were glowing metal, out of the middle of the fire.
units.rightText: And I looked, and, behold, a stormy wind came out of the north, a great cloud, with a fire infolding itself, and a brightness round about it, and out of the midst thereof as it were glowing metal, out of the midst of the fire.
leftNotes: 1:4 “Behold”, from “הִנֵּה*”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.

units.leftText: Out of its center came the likeness of four living creatures. This was their appearance: They had the likeness of a man.
units.rightText: And out of the midst thereof came the likeness of four living creatures. And this was their appearance: they had the likeness of a man;

units.leftText: Everyone had four faces, and each one of them had four wings.
units.rightText: and every one had four faces, and every one of them had four wings.

units.leftText: Their feet were straight feet. The sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf’s foot; and they sparkled like burnished bronze.
units.rightText: And their feet were straight feet; and the sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf’s foot; and they sparkled like burnished brass.

units.leftText: They had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides. The four of them had their faces and their wings like this:
units.rightText: And they had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides; and they four had their faces and their wings thus:

units.leftText: Their wings were joined to one another. They didn’t turn when they went. Each one went straight forward.
units.rightText: their wings were joined one to another; they turned not when they went; they went every one straight forward.

units.leftText: As for the likeness of their faces, they had the face of a man. The four of them had the face of a lion on the right side. The four of them had the face of an ox on the left side. The four of them also had the face of an eagle.
units.rightText: As for the likeness of their faces, they had the face of a man; and they four had the face of a lion on the right side; and they four had the face of an ox on the left side; they four had also the face of an eagle.

units.leftText: Such were their faces. Their wings were spread out above. Two wings of each one touched another, and two covered their bodies.
units.rightText: And their faces and their wings were separate above; two wings of every one were joined one to another, and two covered their bodies.

units.leftText: Each one went straight forward. Where the spirit was to go, they went. They didn’t turn when they went.
units.rightText: And they went every one straight forward: whither the spirit was to go, they went; they turned not when they went.

units.leftText: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, like the appearance of torches. The fire went up and down among the living creatures. The fire was bright, and lightning went out of the fire.
units.rightText: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, like the appearance of torches: the fire went up and down among the living creatures; and the fire was bright, and out of the fire went forth lightning.

units.leftText: The living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.
units.rightText: And the living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.

units.leftText: Now as I saw the living creatures, behold, there was one wheel on the earth beside the living creatures, for each of the four faces of it.
units.rightText: Now as I beheld the living creatures, behold, one wheel upon the earth beside the living creatures, for each of the four faces thereof.

units.leftText: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like a beryl. The four of them had one likeness. Their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel within a wheel.
units.rightText: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like unto a beryl: and they four had one likeness; and their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel within a wheel.

units.leftText: When they went, they went in their four directions. They didn’t turn when they went.
units.rightText: When they went, they went in their four directions: they turned not when they went.

units.leftText: As for their rims, they were high and dreadful; and the four of them had their rims full of eyes all around.
units.rightText: As for their rims, they were high and dreadful; and they four had their rims full of eyes round about.

units.leftText: When the living creatures went, the wheels went beside them. When the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.
units.rightText: And when the living creatures went, the wheels went beside them; and when the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.

units.leftText: Wherever the spirit was to go, they went. The spirit was to go there. The wheels were lifted up beside them; for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
units.rightText: Whithersoever the spirit was to go, they went; thither was the spirit to go: and the wheels were lifted up beside them; for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.

units.leftText: When those went, these went. When those stood, these stood. When those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up beside them; for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
units.rightText: When those went, these went; and when those stood, these stood; and when those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up beside them: for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.

units.leftText: Over the head of the living creature there was the likeness of an expanse, like an awesome crystal to look at, stretched out over their heads above.
units.rightText: And over the head of the living creature there was the likeness of a firmament, like the terrible crystal to look upon, stretched forth over their heads above.

units.leftText: Under the expanse, their wings were straight, one toward the other. Each one had two which covered on this side, and each one had two which covered their bodies on that side.
units.rightText: And under the firmament were their wings straight, the one toward the other: every one had two which covered on this side, and every one had two which covered on that side, their bodies.

units.leftText: When they went, I heard the noise of their wings like the noise of great waters, like the voice of the Almighty, a noise of tumult like the noise of an army. When they stood, they let down their wings.
units.rightText: And when they went, I heard the noise of their wings like the noise of great waters, like the voice of the Almighty, a noise of tumult like the noise of a host: when they stood, they let down their wings.

units.leftText: There was a voice above the expanse that was over their heads. When they stood, they let down their wings.
units.rightText: And there was a voice above the firmament that was over their heads: when they stood, they let down their wings.

units.leftText: Above the expanse that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone. On the likeness of the throne was a likeness as the appearance of a man on it above.
units.rightText: And above the firmament that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone; and upon the likeness of the throne was a likeness as the appearance of a man upon it above.
leftNotes: 1:26 or, lapis lazuli

units.leftText: I saw as it were glowing metal, as the appearance of fire within it all around, from the appearance of his waist and upward; and from the appearance of his waist and downward I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and there was brightness around him.
units.rightText: And I saw as it were glowing metal, as the appearance of fire within it round about, from the appearance of his loins and upward; and from the appearance of his loins and downward I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and there was brightness round about him.

units.leftText: As the appearance of the rainbow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness all around.
units.rightText: As the appearance of the bow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness round about. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of Jehovah. And when I saw it, I fell upon my face, and I heard a voice of one that spake.

units.leftText: He said to me, “Son of man, stand on your feet, and I will speak with you.”
units.rightText: And he said unto me, Son of man, stand upon thy feet, and I will speak with thee.

units.leftText: The Spirit entered into me when he spoke to me, and set me on my feet; and I heard him who spoke to me.
units.rightText: And the Spirit entered into me when he spake unto me, and set me upon my feet; and I heard him that spake unto me.

units.leftText: He said to me, “Son of man, I send you to the children of Israel, to a nation of rebels who have rebelled against me. They and their fathers have transgressed against me even to this very day.
units.rightText: And he said unto me, Son of man, I send thee to the children of Israel, to nations that are rebellious, which have rebelled against me: they and their fathers have transgressed against me even unto this very day.

units.leftText: The children are impudent and stiff-hearted. I am sending you to them, and you shall tell them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says.’
units.rightText: And the children are impudent and stiffhearted: I do send thee unto them; and thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah.
leftNotes: 2:4 The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.”

units.leftText: They, whether they will hear, or whether they will refuse—for they are a rebellious house—yet they will know that there has been a prophet among them.
units.rightText: And they, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear (for they are a rebellious house), yet shall know that there hath been a prophet among them.

units.leftText: You, son of man, don’t be afraid of them, neither be afraid of their words, though briers and thorns are with you, and you dwell among scorpions. Don’t be afraid of their words, nor be dismayed at their looks, though they are a rebellious house.
units.rightText: And thou, son of man, be not afraid of them, neither be afraid of their words, though briers and thorns are with thee, and thou dost dwell among scorpions: be not afraid of their words, nor be dismayed at their looks, though they are a rebellious house.

units.leftText: You shall speak my words to them, whether they will hear or whether they will refuse; for they are most rebellious.
units.rightText: And thou shalt speak my words unto them, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear; for they are most rebellious.

units.leftText: But you, son of man, hear what I tell you. Don’t be rebellious like that rebellious house. Open your mouth, and eat that which I give you.”
units.rightText: But thou, son of man, hear what I say unto thee; be not thou rebellious like that rebellious house: open thy mouth, and eat that which I give thee.

units.leftText: When I looked, behold, a hand was stretched out to me; and behold, a scroll of a book was in it.
units.rightText: And when I looked, behold, a hand was put forth unto me; and, lo, a roll of a book was therein;

units.leftText: He spread it before me. It was written within and without; and lamentations, mourning, and woe were written in it.
units.rightText: and he spread it before me: and it was written within and without; and there were written therein lamentations, and mourning, and woe.

units.leftText: He said to me, “Son of man, eat what you find. Eat this scroll, and go, speak to the house of Israel.”
units.rightText: And he said unto me, Son of man, eat that which thou findest; eat this roll, and go, speak unto the house of Israel.

units.leftText: So I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat the scroll.
units.rightText: So I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat the roll.

units.leftText: He said to me, “Son of man, eat this scroll that I give you and fill your belly and your bowels with it.”
units.rightText: And he said unto me, Son of man, cause thy belly to eat, and fill thy bowels with this roll that I give thee. Then did I eat it; and it was in my mouth as honey for sweetness.

units.leftText: He said to me, “Son of man, go to the house of Israel, and speak my words to them.
units.rightText: And he said unto me, Son of man, go, get thee unto the house of Israel, and speak with my words unto them.

units.leftText: For you are not sent to a people of a strange speech and of a hard language, but to the house of Israel—
units.rightText: For thou art not sent to a people of a strange speech and of a hard language, but to the house of Israel;

units.leftText: not to many peoples of a strange speech and of a hard language, whose words you can’t understand. Surely, if I sent you to them, they would listen to you.
units.rightText: not to many peoples of a strange speech and of a hard language, whose words thou canst not understand. Surely, if I sent thee to them, they would hearken unto thee.

units.leftText: But the house of Israel will not listen to you, for they will not listen to me; for all the house of Israel are obstinate and hard-hearted.
units.rightText: But the house of Israel will not hearken unto thee; for they will not hearken unto me: for all the house of Israel are of a hard forehead and of a stiff heart.
leftNotes: 3:7 Literally, have a hard forehead

units.leftText: Behold, I have made your face hard against their faces, and your forehead hard against their foreheads.
units.rightText: Behold, I have made thy face hard against their faces, and thy forehead hard against their foreheads.

units.leftText: I have made your forehead as a diamond, harder than flint. Don’t be afraid of them, neither be dismayed at their looks, though they are a rebellious house.”
units.rightText: As an adamant harder than flint have I made thy forehead: fear them not, neither be dismayed at their looks, though they are a rebellious house.

units.leftText: Moreover he said to me, “Son of man, receive in your heart and hear with your ears all my words that I speak to you.
units.rightText: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, all my words that I shall speak unto thee receive in thy heart, and hear with thine ears.

units.leftText: Go to them of the captivity, to the children of your people, and speak to them, and tell them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says,’ whether they will hear, or whether they will refuse.”
units.rightText: And go, get thee to them of the captivity, unto the children of thy people, and speak unto them, and tell them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah; whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear.

units.leftText: Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me the voice of a great rushing, saying, “Blessed be the LORD’s glory from his place.”
units.rightText: Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me the voice of a great rushing, saying, Blessed be the glory of Jehovah from his place.

units.leftText: I heard the noise of the wings of the living creatures as they touched one another, and the noise of the wheels beside them, even the noise of a great rushing.
units.rightText: And I heard the noise of the wings of the living creatures as they touched one another, and the noise of the wheels beside them, even the noise of a great rushing.

units.leftText: So the Spirit lifted me up, and took me away; and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; and the LORD’s hand was strong on me.
units.rightText: So the Spirit lifted me up, and took me away; and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; and the hand of Jehovah was strong upon me.

units.leftText: Then I came to them of the captivity at Tel Aviv who lived by the river Chebar, and to where they lived; and I sat there overwhelmed among them seven days.
units.rightText: Then I came to them of the captivity at Tel-abib, that dwelt by the river Chebar, and to where they dwelt; and I sat there overwhelmed among them seven days.

units.leftText: At the end of seven days, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And it came to pass at the end of seven days, that the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, I have made you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore hear the word from my mouth, and warn them from me.
units.rightText: Son of man, I have made thee a watchman unto the house of Israel: therefore hear the word at my mouth, and give them warning from me.

units.leftText: When I tell the wicked, ‘You will surely die;’ and you give him no warning, nor speak to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life, that wicked man will die in his iniquity; but I will require his blood at your hand.
units.rightText: When I say unto the wicked, Thou shalt surely die; and thou givest him not warning, nor speakest to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life; the same wicked man shall die in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at thy hand.

units.leftText: Yet if you warn the wicked, and he doesn’t turn from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he will die in his iniquity; but you have delivered your soul.”
units.rightText: Yet if thou warn the wicked, and he turn not from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he shall die in his iniquity; but thou hast delivered thy soul.

units.leftText: “Again, when a righteous man turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, and I lay a stumbling block before him, he will die. Because you have not given him warning, he will die in his sin, and his righteous deeds which he has done will not be remembered; but I will require his blood at your hand.
units.rightText: Again, when a righteous man doth turn from his righteousness, and commit iniquity, and I lay a stumblingblock before him, he shall die: because thou hast not given him warning, he shall die in his sin, and his righteous deeds which he hath done shall not be remembered; but his blood will I require at thy hand.

units.leftText: Nevertheless if you warn the righteous man, that the righteous not sin, and he does not sin, he will surely live, because he took warning; and you have delivered your soul.”
units.rightText: Nevertheless if thou warn the righteous man, that the righteous sin not, and he doth not sin, he shall surely live, because he took warning; and thou hast delivered thy soul.

units.leftText: The LORD’s hand was there on me; and he said to me, “Arise, go out into the plain, and I will talk with you there.”
units.rightText: And the hand of Jehovah was there upon me; and he said unto me, Arise, go forth into the plain, and I will there talk with thee.

units.leftText: Then I arose, and went out into the plain, and behold, the LORD’s glory stood there, like the glory which I saw by the river Chebar. Then I fell on my face.
units.rightText: Then I arose, and went forth into the plain: and, behold, the glory of Jehovah stood there, as the glory which I saw by the river Chebar; and I fell on my face.

units.leftText: Then the Spirit entered into me and set me on my feet. He spoke with me, and said to me, “Go, shut yourself inside your house.
units.rightText: Then the Spirit entered into me, and set me upon my feet; and he spake with me, and said unto me, Go, shut thyself within thy house.

units.leftText: But you, son of man, behold, they will put ropes on you, and will bind you with them, and you will not go out among them.
units.rightText: But thou, son of man, behold, they shall lay bands upon thee, and shall bind thee with them, and thou shalt not go out among them:

units.leftText: I will make your tongue stick to the roof of your mouth so that you will be mute and will not be able to correct them, for they are a rebellious house.
units.rightText: and I will make thy tongue cleave to the roof of thy mouth, that thou shalt be dumb, and shalt not be to them a reprover; for they are a rebellious house.

units.leftText: But when I speak with you, I will open your mouth, and you shall tell them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says.’ He who hears, let him hear; and he who refuses, let him refuse; for they are a rebellious house.”
units.rightText: But when I speak with thee, I will open thy mouth, and thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: He that heareth, let him hear; and he that forbeareth, let him forbear: for they are a rebellious house.

units.leftText: “You also, son of man, take a tile, and lay it before yourself, and portray on it a city, even Jerusalem.
units.rightText: Thou also, son of man, take thee a tile, and lay it before thee, and portray upon it a city, even Jerusalem:

units.leftText: Lay siege against it, build forts against it, and cast up a mound against it. Also set camps against it and plant battering rams against it all around.
units.rightText: and lay siege against it, and build forts against it, and cast up a mound against it; set camps also against it, and plant battering rams against it round about.

units.leftText: Take for yourself an iron pan and set it for a wall of iron between you and the city. Then set your face toward it. It will be besieged, and you shall lay siege against it. This shall be a sign to the house of Israel.
units.rightText: And take thou unto thee an iron pan, and set it for a wall of iron between thee and the city: and set thy face toward it, and it shall be besieged, and thou shalt lay siege against it. This shall be a sign to the house of Israel.

units.leftText: “Moreover lie on your left side, and lay the iniquity of the house of Israel on it. According to the number of the days that you shall lie on it, you shall bear their iniquity.
units.rightText: Moreover lie thou upon thy left side, and lay the iniquity of the house of Israel upon it; according to the number of the days that thou shalt lie upon it, thou shalt bear their iniquity.

units.leftText: For I have appointed the years of their iniquity to be to you a number of days, even three hundred ninety days. So you shall bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.
units.rightText: For I have appointed the years of their iniquity to be unto thee a number of days, even three hundred and ninety days: so shalt thou bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.

units.leftText: “Again, when you have accomplished these, you shall lie on your right side, and shall bear the iniquity of the house of Judah. I have appointed forty days, each day for a year, to you.
units.rightText: And again, when thou hast accomplished these, thou shalt lie on thy right side, and shalt bear the iniquity of the house of Judah: forty days, each day for a year, have I appointed it unto thee.

units.leftText: You shall set your face toward the siege of Jerusalem, with your arm uncovered; and you shall prophesy against it.
units.rightText: And thou shalt set thy face toward the siege of Jerusalem, with thine arm uncovered; and thou shalt prophesy against it.

units.leftText: Behold, I put ropes on you, and you shall not turn yourself from one side to the other, until you have accomplished the days of your siege.
units.rightText: And, behold, I lay bands upon thee, and thou shalt not turn thee from one side to the other, till thou hast accomplished the days of thy siege.

units.leftText: “Take for yourself also wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet, and spelt, and put them in one vessel. Make bread of it. According to the number of the days that you will lie on your side, even three hundred ninety days, you shall eat of it.
units.rightText: Take thou also unto thee wheat, and barley, and beans, and lentils, and millet, and spelt, and put them in one vessel, and make thee bread thereof; according to the number of the days that thou shalt lie upon thy side, even three hundred and ninety days, shalt thou eat thereof.

units.leftText: Your food which you shall eat shall be by weight, twenty shekels a day. From time to time you shall eat it.
units.rightText: And thy food which thou shalt eat shall be by weight, twenty shekels a day: from time to time shalt thou eat it.
leftNotes: 4:10 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces.

units.leftText: You shall drink water by measure, the sixth part of a hin. From time to time you shall drink.
units.rightText: And thou shalt drink water by measure, the sixth part of a hin: from time to time shalt thou drink.
leftNotes: 4:11 A hin is about 6.5 liters or 1.7 gallons.

units.leftText: You shall eat it as barley cakes, and you shall bake it in their sight with dung that comes out of man.”
units.rightText: And thou shalt eat it as barley cakes, and thou shalt bake it in their sight with dung that cometh out of man.

units.leftText: The LORD said, “Even thus will the children of Israel eat their bread unclean, among the nations where I will drive them.”
units.rightText: And Jehovah said, Even thus shall the children of Israel eat their bread unclean, among the nations whither I will drive them.

units.leftText: Then I said, “Ah Lord GOD! Behold, my soul has not been polluted; for from my youth up even until now I have not eaten of that which dies of itself, or is torn of animals. No abominable meat has come into my mouth!”
units.rightText: Then said I, Ah Lord Jehovah! behold, my soul hath not been polluted; for from my youth up even till now have I not eaten of that which dieth of itself, or is torn of beasts; neither came there abominable flesh into my mouth.

units.leftText: Then he said to me, “Behold, I have given you cow’s dung for man’s dung, and you shall prepare your bread on it.”
units.rightText: Then he said unto me, See, I have given thee cow’s dung for man’s dung, and thou shalt prepare thy bread thereon.

units.leftText: Moreover he said to me, “Son of man, behold, I will break the staff of bread in Jerusalem. They will eat bread by weight, and with fearfulness. They will drink water by measure, and in dismay;
units.rightText: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, behold, I will break the staff of bread in Jerusalem: and they shall eat bread by weight, and with fearfulness; and they shall drink water by measure, and in dismay:

units.leftText: that they may lack bread and water, be dismayed one with another, and pine away in their iniquity.
units.rightText: that they may want bread and water, and be dismayed one with another, and pine away in their iniquity.

units.leftText: “You, son of man, take a sharp sword. You shall take it as a barber’s razor to yourself, and shall cause it to pass over your head and over your beard. Then take balances to weigh and divide the hair.
units.rightText: And thou, son of man, take thee a sharp sword; as a barber’s razor shalt thou take it unto thee, and shalt cause it to pass upon thy head and upon thy beard: then take thee balances to weigh, and divide the hair.

units.leftText: A third part you shall burn in the fire in the middle of the city, when the days of the siege are fulfilled. You shall take a third part, and strike with the sword around it. A third part you shall scatter to the wind, and I will draw out a sword after them.
units.rightText: A third part shalt thou burn in the fire in the midst of the city, when the days of the siege are fulfilled; and thou shalt take a third part, and smite with the sword round about it; and a third part thou shalt scatter to the wind, and I will draw out a sword after them.

units.leftText: You shall take a small number of these and bind them in the folds of your robe.
units.rightText: And thou shalt take thereof a few in number, and bind them in thy skirts.

units.leftText: Of these again you shall take, and cast them into the middle of the fire, and burn them in the fire. From it a fire will come out into all the house of Israel.
units.rightText: And of these again shalt thou take, and cast them into the midst of the fire, and burn them in the fire; therefrom shall a fire come forth into all the house of Israel.

units.leftText: “The Lord GOD says: ‘This is Jerusalem. I have set her in the middle of the nations, and countries are around her.
units.rightText: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: This is Jerusalem; I have set her in the midst of the nations, and countries are round about her.

units.leftText: She has rebelled against my ordinances in doing wickedness more than the nations, and against my statutes more than the countries that are around her; for they have rejected my ordinances, and as for my statutes, they have not walked in them.’
units.rightText: And she hath rebelled against mine ordinances in doing wickedness more than the nations, and against my statutes more than the countries that are round about her; for they have rejected mine ordinances, and as for my statutes, they have not walked in them.

units.leftText: “Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Because you are more turbulent than the nations that are around you, and have not walked in my statutes, neither have kept my ordinances, neither have followed the ordinances of the nations that are around you;
units.rightText: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because ye are turbulent more than the nations that are round about you, and have not walked in my statutes, neither have kept mine ordinances, neither have done after the ordinances of the nations that are round about you;

units.leftText: therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I, even I, am against you; and I will execute judgments among you in the sight of the nations.
units.rightText: therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I, even I, am against thee; and I will execute judgments in the midst of thee in the sight of the nations.

units.leftText: I will do in you that which I have not done, and which I will not do anything like it any more, because of all your abominations.
units.rightText: And I will do in thee that which I have not done, and whereunto I will not do any more the like, because of all thine abominations.

units.leftText: Therefore the fathers will eat the sons within you, and the sons will eat their fathers. I will execute judgments on you; and I will scatter the whole remnant of you to all the winds.
units.rightText: Therefore the fathers shall eat the sons in the midst of thee, and the sons shall eat their fathers; and I will execute judgments on thee; and the whole remnant of thee will I scatter unto all the winds.

units.leftText: Therefore as I live,’ says the Lord GOD, ‘surely, because you have defiled my sanctuary with all your detestable things, and with all your abominations, therefore I will also diminish you. My eye won’t spare, and I will have no pity.
units.rightText: Wherefore, as I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, surely, because thou hast defiled my sanctuary with all thy detestable things, and with all thine abominations, therefore will I also diminish thee; neither shall mine eye spare, and I also will have no pity.

units.leftText: A third part of you will die with the pestilence, and they will be consumed with famine within you. A third part will fall by the sword around you. A third part I will scatter to all the winds, and will draw out a sword after them.
units.rightText: A third part of thee shall die with the pestilence, and with famine shall they be consumed in the midst of thee; and a third part shall fall by the sword round about thee; and a third part I will scatter unto all the winds, and will draw out a sword after them.

units.leftText: “‘Thus my anger will be accomplished, and I will cause my wrath toward them to rest, and I will be comforted. They will know that I, the LORD, have spoken in my zeal, when I have accomplished my wrath on them.
units.rightText: Thus shall mine anger be accomplished, and I will cause my wrath toward them to rest, and I shall be comforted: and they shall know that I, Jehovah, have spoken in my zeal, when I have accomplished my wrath upon them.

units.leftText: “‘Moreover I will make you a desolation and a reproach among the nations that are around you, in the sight of all that pass by.
units.rightText: Moreover I will make thee a desolation and a reproach among the nations that are round about thee, in the sight of all that pass by.

units.leftText: So it will be a reproach and a taunt, an instruction and an astonishment, to the nations that are around you, when I execute judgments on you in anger and in wrath, and in wrathful rebukes—I, the LORD, have spoken it—
units.rightText: So it shall be a reproach and a taunt, an instruction and an astonishment, unto the nations that are round about thee, when I shall execute judgments on thee in anger and in wrath, and in wrathful rebukes (I, Jehovah, have spoken it);

units.leftText: when I send on them the evil arrows of famine that are for destruction, which I will send to destroy you. I will increase the famine on you and will break your staff of bread.
units.rightText: when I shall send upon them the evil arrows of famine, that are for destruction, which I will send to destroy you. And I will increase the famine upon you, and will break your staff of bread;

units.leftText: I will send on you famine and evil animals, and they will bereave you. Pestilence and blood will pass through you. I will bring the sword on you. I, the LORD, have spoken it.’”
units.rightText: and I will send upon you famine and evil beasts, and they shall bereave thee; and pestilence and blood shall pass through thee; and I will bring the sword upon thee: I, Jehovah, have spoken it.

units.leftText: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, set your face toward the mountains of Israel, and prophesy to them,
units.rightText: Son of man, set thy face toward the mountains of Israel, and prophesy unto them,

units.leftText: and say, ‘You mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD! The Lord GOD says to the mountains and to the hills, to the watercourses and to the valleys: “Behold, I, even I, will bring a sword on you, and I will destroy your high places.
units.rightText: and say, Ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord Jehovah: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah to the mountains and to the hills, to the watercourses and to the valleys: Behold, I, even I, will bring a sword upon you, and I will destroy your high places.

units.leftText: Your altars will become desolate, and your incense altars will be broken. I will cast down your slain men before your idols.
units.rightText: And your altars shall become desolate, and your sun-images shall be broken; and I will cast down your slain men before your idols.

units.leftText: I will lay the dead bodies of the children of Israel before their idols. I will scatter your bones around your altars.
units.rightText: And I will lay the dead bodies of the children of Israel before their idols; and I will scatter your bones round about your altars.

units.leftText: In all your dwelling places, the cities will be laid waste and the high places will be desolate, so that your altars may be laid waste and made desolate, and your idols may be broken and cease, and your incense altars may be cut down, and your works may be abolished.
units.rightText: In all your dwelling-places the cities shall be laid waste, and the high places shall be desolate; that your altars may be laid waste and made desolate, and your idols may be broken and cease, and your sun-images may be hewn down, and your works may be abolished.

units.leftText: The slain will fall among you, and you will know that I am the LORD.
units.rightText: And the slain shall fall in the midst of you, and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: “‘“Yet I will leave a remnant, in that you will have some that escape the sword among the nations, when you are scattered through the countries.
units.rightText: Yet will I leave a remnant, in that ye shall have some that escape the sword among the nations, when ye shall be scattered through the countries.

units.leftText: Those of you that escape will remember me among the nations where they are carried captive, how I have been broken with their lewd heart, which has departed from me, and with their eyes, which play the prostitute after their idols. Then they will loathe themselves in their own sight for the evils which they have committed in all their abominations.
units.rightText: And those of you that escape shall remember me among the nations whither they shall be carried captive, how that I have been broken with their lewd heart, which hath departed from me, and with their eyes, which play the harlot after their idols: and they shall loathe themselves in their own sight for the evils which they have committed in all their abominations.

units.leftText: They will know that I am the LORD. I have not said in vain that I would do this evil to them.”’
units.rightText: And they shall know that I am Jehovah: I have not said in vain that I would do this evil unto them.

units.leftText: “The Lord GOD says: ‘Strike with your hand, and stamp with your foot, and say, “Alas!”, because of all the evil abominations of the house of Israel; for they will fall by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence.
units.rightText: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Smite with thy hand, and stamp with thy foot, and say, Alas! because of all the evil abominations of the house of Israel; for they shall fall by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence.

units.leftText: He who is far off will die of the pestilence. He who is near will fall by the sword. He who remains and is besieged will die by the famine. Thus I will accomplish my wrath on them.
units.rightText: He that is far off shall die of the pestilence; and he that is near shall fall by the sword; and he that remaineth and is besieged shall die by the famine: thus will I accomplish my wrath upon them.

units.leftText: You will know that I am the LORD when their slain men are among their idols around their altars, on every high hill, on all the tops of the mountains, under every green tree, and under every thick oak—the places where they offered pleasant aroma to all their idols.
units.rightText: And ye shall know that I am Jehovah, when their slain men shall be among their idols round about their altars, upon every high hill, on all the tops of the mountains, and under every green tree, and under every thick oak, the places where they offered sweet savor to all their idols.

units.leftText: I will stretch out my hand on them and make the land desolate and waste, from the wilderness toward Diblah, throughout all their habitations. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’”
units.rightText: And I will stretch out my hand upon them, and make the land desolate and waste, from the wilderness toward Diblah, throughout all their habitations: and they shall know that I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: Moreover the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “You, son of man, the Lord GOD says to the land of Israel, ‘An end! The end has come on the four corners of the land.
units.rightText: And thou, son of man, thus saith the Lord Jehovah unto the land of Israel, An end: the end is come upon the four corners of the land.

units.leftText: Now the end is on you, and I will send my anger on you, and will judge you according to your ways. I will bring on you all your abominations.
units.rightText: Now is the end upon thee, and I will send mine anger upon thee, and will judge thee according to thy ways; and I will bring upon thee all thine abominations.

units.leftText: My eye will not spare you, neither will I have pity; but I will bring your ways on you, and your abominations will be among you. Then you will know that I am the LORD.’
units.rightText: And mine eye shall not spare thee, neither will I have pity; but I will bring thy ways upon thee, and thine abominations shall be in the midst of thee: and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: “The Lord GOD says: ‘A disaster! A unique disaster! Behold, it comes.
units.rightText: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: An evil, an only evil; behold, it cometh.

units.leftText: An end has come. The end has come! It awakes against you. Behold, it comes.
units.rightText: An end is come, the end is come; it awaketh against thee; behold, it cometh.

units.leftText: Your doom has come to you, inhabitant of the land! The time has come! The day is near, a day of tumult, and not of joyful shouting, on the mountains.
units.rightText: Thy doom is come unto thee, O inhabitant of the land: the time is come, the day is near, a day of tumult, and not of joyful shouting, upon the mountains.

units.leftText: Now I will shortly pour out my wrath on you, and accomplish my anger against you, and will judge you according to your ways. I will bring on you all your abominations.
units.rightText: Now will I shortly pour out my wrath upon thee, and accomplish mine anger against thee, and will judge thee according to thy ways; and I will bring upon thee all thine abominations.

units.leftText: My eye won’t spare, neither will I have pity. I will punish you according to your ways. Your abominations will be among you. Then you will know that I, the LORD, strike.
units.rightText: And mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: I will bring upon thee according to thy ways; and thine abominations shall be in the midst of thee; and ye shall know that I, Jehovah, do smite.

units.leftText: “‘Behold, the day! Behold, it comes! Your doom has gone out. The rod has blossomed. Pride has budded.
units.rightText: Behold, the day, behold, it cometh: thy doom is gone forth; the rod hath blossomed, pride hath budded.

units.leftText: Violence has risen up into a rod of wickedness. None of them will remain, nor of their multitude, nor of their wealth. There will be nothing of value among them.
units.rightText: Violence is risen up into a rod of wickedness; none of them shall remain, nor of their multitude, nor of their wealth: neither shall there be eminency among them.

units.leftText: The time has come! The day draws near. Don’t let the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn; for wrath is on all its multitude.
units.rightText: The time is come, the day draweth near: let not the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn; for wrath is upon all the multitude thereof.

units.leftText: For the seller won’t return to that which is sold, although they are still alive; for the vision concerns the whole multitude of it. None will return. None will strengthen himself in the iniquity of his life.
units.rightText: For the seller shall not return to that which is sold, although they be yet alive: for the vision is touching the whole multitude thereof, none shall return; neither shall any strengthen himself in the iniquity of his life.

units.leftText: They have blown the trumpet, and have made all ready; but no one goes to the battle, for my wrath is on all its multitude.
units.rightText: They have blown the trumpet, and have made all ready; but none goeth to the battle; for my wrath is upon all the multitude thereof.

units.leftText: “‘The sword is outside, and the pestilence and the famine within. He who is in the field will die by the sword. He who is in the city will be devoured by famine and pestilence.
units.rightText: The sword is without, and the pestilence and the famine within: he that is in the field shall die with the sword; and he that is in the city, famine and pestilence shall devour him.

units.leftText: But of those who escape, they will escape and will be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them moaning, everyone in his iniquity.
units.rightText: But those of them that escape shall escape, and shall be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them moaning, every one in his iniquity.

units.leftText: All hands will be feeble, and all knees will be weak as water.
units.rightText: All hands shall be feeble, and all knees shall be weak as water.

units.leftText: They will also clothe themselves with sackcloth, and horror will cover them. Shame will be on all faces, and baldness on all their heads.
units.rightText: They shall also gird themselves with sackcloth, and horror shall cover them; and shame shall be upon all faces, and baldness upon all their heads.

units.leftText: They will cast their silver in the streets, and their gold will be as an unclean thing. Their silver and their gold won’t be able to deliver them in the day of the LORD’s wrath. They won’t satisfy their souls or fill their bellies; because it has been the stumbling block of their iniquity.
units.rightText: They shall cast their silver in the streets, and their gold shall be as an unclean thing; their silver and their gold shall not be able to deliver them in the day of the wrath of Jehovah: they shall not satisfy their souls, neither fill their bowels; because it hath been the stumblingblock of their iniquity.

units.leftText: As for the beauty of his ornament, he set it in majesty; but they made the images of their abominations and their detestable things therein. Therefore I have made it to them as an unclean thing.
units.rightText: As for the beauty of his ornament, he set it in majesty; but they made the images of their abominations and their detestable things therein: therefore have I made it unto them as an unclean thing.

units.leftText: I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey, and to the wicked of the earth for a plunder; and they will profane it.
units.rightText: And I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey, and to the wicked of the earth for a spoil; and they shall profane it.

units.leftText: I will also turn my face from them, and they will profane my secret place. Robbers will enter into it, and profane it.
units.rightText: My face will I turn also from them, and they shall profane my secret place; and robbers shall enter into it, and profane it.

units.leftText: “‘Make chains, for the land is full of bloody crimes, and the city is full of violence.
units.rightText: Make the chain; for the land is full of bloody crimes, and the city is full of violence.

units.leftText: Therefore I will bring the worst of the nations, and they will possess their houses. I will also make the pride of the strong to cease. Their holy places will be profaned.
units.rightText: Wherefore I will bring the worst of the nations, and they shall possess their houses: I will also make the pride of the strong to cease; and their holy places shall be profaned.

units.leftText: Destruction comes! They will seek peace, and there will be none.
units.rightText: Destruction cometh; and they shall seek peace, and there shall be none.

units.leftText: Mischief will come on mischief, and rumor will be on rumor. They will seek a vision of the prophet; but the law will perish from the priest, and counsel from the elders.
units.rightText: Mischief shall come upon mischief, and rumor shall be upon rumor; and they shall seek a vision of the prophet; but the law shall perish from the priest, and counsel from the elders.

units.leftText: The king will mourn, and the prince will be clothed with desolation. The hands of the people of the land will be troubled. I will do to them after their way, and according to their own judgments I will judge them. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’”
units.rightText: The king shall mourn, and the prince shall be clothed with desolation, and the hands of the people of the land shall be troubled: I will do unto them after their way, and according to their deserts will I judge them; and they shall know that I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: In the sixth year, in the sixth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I sat in my house, and the elders of Judah sat before me, the Lord GOD’s hand fell on me there.
units.rightText: And it came to pass in the sixth year, in the sixth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I sat in my house, and the elders of Judah sat before me, that the hand of the Lord Jehovah fell there upon me.

units.leftText: Then I saw, and behold, a likeness as the appearance of fire—from the appearance of his waist and downward, fire, and from his waist and upward, as the appearance of brightness, as it were glowing metal.
units.rightText: Then I beheld, and, lo, a likeness as the appearance of fire; from the appearance of his loins and downward, fire; and from his loins and upward, as the appearance of brightness, as it were glowing metal.

units.leftText: He stretched out the form of a hand, and took me by a lock of my head; and the Spirit lifted me up between earth and the sky, and brought me in the visions of God to Jerusalem, to the door of the gate of the inner court that looks toward the north, where there was the seat of the image of jealousy, which provokes to jealousy.
units.rightText: And he put forth the form of a hand, and took me by a lock of my head; and the Spirit lifted me up between earth and heaven, and brought me in the visions of God to Jerusalem, to the door of the gate of the inner court that looketh toward the north; where was the seat of the image of jealousy, which provoketh to jealousy.

units.leftText: Behold, the glory of the God of Israel was there, according to the appearance that I saw in the plain.
units.rightText: And, behold, the glory of the God of Israel was there, according to the appearance that I saw in the plain.

units.leftText: Then he said to me, “Son of man, lift up your eyes now the way toward the north.”
units.rightText: Then said he unto me, Son of man, lift up thine eyes now the way toward the north. So I lifted up mine eyes the way toward the north, and behold, northward of the gate of the altar this image of jealousy in the entry.

units.leftText: He said to me, “Son of man, do you see what they do? Even the great abominations that the house of Israel commit here, that I should go far off from my sanctuary? But you will again see yet other great abominations.”
units.rightText: And he said unto me, Son of man, seest thou what they do? even the great abominations that the house of Israel do commit here, that I should go far off from my sanctuary? But thou shalt again see yet other great abominations.

units.leftText: He brought me to the door of the court; and when I looked, behold, a hole in the wall.
units.rightText: And he brought me to the door of the court; and when I looked, behold, a hole in the wall.

units.leftText: Then he said to me, “Son of man, dig now in the wall.”
units.rightText: Then said he unto me, Son of man, dig now in the wall: and when I had digged in the wall, behold, a door.

units.leftText: He said to me, “Go in, and see the wicked abominations that they do here.”
units.rightText: And he said unto me, Go in, and see the wicked abominations that they do here.

units.leftText: So I went in and looked, and saw every form of creeping things, abominable animals, and all the idols of the house of Israel, portrayed around on the wall.
units.rightText: So I went in and saw; and behold, every form of creeping things, and abominable beasts, and all the idols of the house of Israel, portrayed upon the wall round about.

units.leftText: Seventy men of the elders of the house of Israel stood before them. In the middle of them Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan stood, every man with his censer in his hand; and the smell of the cloud of incense went up.
units.rightText: And there stood before them seventy men of the elders of the house of Israel; and in the midst of them stood Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan, every man with his censer in his hand; and the odor of the cloud of incense went up.

units.leftText: Then he said to me, “Son of man, have you seen what the elders of the house of Israel do in the dark, every man in his rooms of imagery? For they say, ‘The LORD doesn’t see us. The LORD has forsaken the land.’”
units.rightText: Then said he unto me, Son of man, hast thou seen what the elders of the house of Israel do in the dark, every man in his chambers of imagery? for they say, Jehovah seeth us not; Jehovah hath forsaken the land.

units.leftText: He said also to me, “You will again see more of the great abominations which they do.”
units.rightText: He said also unto me, Thou shalt again see yet other great abominations which they do.

units.leftText: Then he brought me to the door of the gate of the LORD’s house which was toward the north; and I saw the women sit there weeping for Tammuz.
units.rightText: Then he brought me to the door of the gate of Jehovah’s house which was toward the north; and behold, there sat the women weeping for Tammuz.

units.leftText: Then he said to me, “Have you seen this, son of man? You will again see yet greater abominations than these.”
units.rightText: Then said he unto me, Hast thou seen this, O son of man? thou shalt again see yet greater abominations than these.

units.leftText: He brought me into the inner court of the LORD’s house; and I saw at the door of the LORD’s temple, between the porch and the altar, there were about twenty-five men with their backs toward the LORD’s temple and their faces toward the east. They were worshiping the sun toward the east.
units.rightText: And he brought me into the inner court of Jehovah’s house; and behold, at the door of the temple of Jehovah, between the porch and the altar, were about five and twenty men, with their backs toward the temple of Jehovah, and their faces toward the east; and they were worshipping the sun toward the east.

units.leftText: Then he said to me, “Have you seen this, son of man? Is it a light thing to the house of Judah that they commit the abominations which they commit here? For they have filled the land with violence, and have turned again to provoke me to anger. Behold, they put the branch to their nose.
units.rightText: Then he said unto me, Hast thou seen this, O son of man? Is it a light thing to the house of Judah that they commit the abominations which they commit here? for they have filled the land with violence, and have turned again to provoke me to anger: and, lo, they put the branch to their nose.

units.leftText: Therefore I will also deal in wrath. My eye won’t spare, neither will I have pity. Though they cry in my ears with a loud voice, yet I will not hear them.”
units.rightText: Therefore will I also deal in wrath; mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity; and though they cry in mine ears with a loud voice, yet will I not hear them.

units.leftText: Then he cried in my ears with a loud voice, saying, “Cause those who are in charge of the city to draw near, each man with his destroying weapon in his hand.”
units.rightText: Then he cried in mine ears with a loud voice, saying, Cause ye them that have charge over the city to draw near, every man with his destroying weapon in his hand.

units.leftText: Behold, six men came from the way of the upper gate, which lies toward the north, every man with his slaughter weapon in his hand. One man in the middle of them was clothed in linen, with a writer’s inkhorn by his side. They went in, and stood beside the bronze altar.
units.rightText: And behold, six men came from the way of the upper gate, which lieth toward the north, every man with his slaughter weapon in his hand; and one man in the midst of them clothed in linen, with a writer’s inkhorn by his side. And they went in, and stood beside the brazen altar.

units.leftText: The glory of the God of Israel went up from the cherub, whereupon it was, to the threshold of the house; and he called to the man clothed in linen, who had the writer’s inkhorn by his side.
units.rightText: And the glory of the God of Israel was gone up from the cherub, whereupon it was, to the threshold of the house: and he called to the man clothed in linen, who had the writer’s inkhorn by his side.

units.leftText: The LORD said to him, “Go through the middle of the city, through the middle of Jerusalem, and set a mark on the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry over all the abominations that are done within it.”
units.rightText: And Jehovah said unto him, Go through the midst of the city, through the midst of Jerusalem, and set a mark upon the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry over all the abominations that are done in the midst thereof.

units.leftText: To the others he said in my hearing, “Go through the city after him, and strike. Don’t let your eye spare, neither have pity.
units.rightText: And to the others he said in my hearing, Go ye through the city after him, and smite: let not your eye spare, neither have ye pity;

units.leftText: Kill utterly the old man, the young man, the virgin, little children and women; but don’t come near any man on whom is the mark. Begin at my sanctuary.”
units.rightText: slay utterly the old man, the young man and the virgin, and little children and women; but come not near any man upon whom is the mark: and begin at my sanctuary. Then they began at the old men that were before the house.

units.leftText: He said to them, “Defile the house, and fill the courts with the slain. Go out!”
units.rightText: And he said unto them, Defile the house, and fill the courts with the slain: go ye forth. And they went forth, and smote in the city.

units.leftText: While they were killing, and I was left, I fell on my face, and cried, and said, “Ah Lord GOD! Will you destroy all the residue of Israel in your pouring out of your wrath on Jerusalem?”
units.rightText: And it came to pass, while they were smiting, and I was left, that I fell upon my face, and cried, and said, Ah Lord Jehovah! wilt thou destroy all the residue of Israel in thy pouring out of thy wrath upon Jerusalem?

units.leftText: Then he said to me, “The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah is exceedingly great, and the land is full of blood, and the city full of perversion; for they say, ‘The LORD has forsaken the land, and the LORD doesn’t see.’
units.rightText: Then said he unto me, The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah is exceeding great, and the land is full of blood, and the city full of wresting of judgment: for they say, Jehovah hath forsaken the land, and Jehovah seeth not.

units.leftText: As for me also, my eye won’t spare, neither will I have pity, but I will bring their way on their head.”
units.rightText: And as for me also, mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity, but I will bring their way upon their head.

units.leftText: Behold, the man clothed in linen, who had the inkhorn by his side, reported the matter, saying, “I have done as you have commanded me.”
units.rightText: And, behold, the man clothed in linen, who had the inkhorn by his side, reported the matter, saying, I have done as thou hast commanded me.

units.leftText: Then I looked, and see, in the expanse that was over the head of the cherubim there appeared above them as it were a sapphire stone, as the appearance of the likeness of a throne.
units.rightText: Then I looked, and, behold, in the firmament that was over the head of the cherubim there appeared above them as it were a sapphire stone, as the appearance of the likeness of a throne.
leftNotes: 10:1 or, lapis lazuli

units.leftText: He spoke to the man clothed in linen, and said, “Go in between the whirling wheels, even under the cherub, and fill both your hands with coals of fire from between the cherubim, and scatter them over the city.”
units.rightText: And he spake unto the man clothed in linen, and said, Go in between the whirling wheels, even under the cherub, and fill both thy hands with coals of fire from between the cherubim, and scatter them over the city. And he went in in my sight.

units.leftText: Now the cherubim stood on the right side of the house when the man went in; and the cloud filled the inner court.
units.rightText: Now the cherubim stood on the right side of the house, when the man went in; and the cloud filled the inner court.

units.leftText: The LORD’s glory mounted up from the cherub, and stood over the threshold of the house; and the house was filled with the cloud, and the court was full of the brightness of the LORD’s glory.
units.rightText: And the glory of Jehovah mounted up from the cherub, and stood over the threshold of the house; and the house was filled with the cloud, and the court was full of the brightness of Jehovah’s glory.

units.leftText: The sound of the wings of the cherubim was heard even to the outer court, as the voice of God Almighty when he speaks.
units.rightText: And the sound of the wings of the cherubim was heard even to the outer court, as the voice of God Almighty when he speaketh.

units.leftText: It came to pass, when he commanded the man clothed in linen, saying, “Take fire from between the whirling wheels, from between the cherubim,” that he went in and stood beside a wheel.
units.rightText: And it came to pass, when he commanded the man clothed in linen, saying, Take fire from between the whirling wheels, from between the cherubim, that he went in, and stood beside a wheel.

units.leftText: The cherub stretched out his hand from between the cherubim to the fire that was between the cherubim, and took some of it, and put it into the hands of him who was clothed in linen, who took it and went out.
units.rightText: And the cherub stretched forth his hand from between the cherubim unto the fire that was between the cherubim, and took thereof, and put it into the hands of him that was clothed in linen, who took it and went out.

units.leftText: The form of a man’s hand appeared here in the cherubim under their wings.
units.rightText: And there appeared in the cherubim the form of a man’s hand under their wings.

units.leftText: I looked, and behold, there were four wheels beside the cherubim, one wheel beside one cherub, and another wheel beside another cherub. The appearance of the wheels was like a beryl stone.
units.rightText: And I looked, and behold, four wheels beside the cherubim, one wheel beside one cherub, and another wheel beside another cherub; and the appearance of the wheels was like unto a beryl stone.

units.leftText: As for their appearance, the four of them had one likeness, like a wheel within a wheel.
units.rightText: And as for their appearance, they four had one likeness, as if a wheel had been within a wheel.

units.leftText: When they went, they went in their four directions. They didn’t turn as they went, but to the place where the head looked they followed it. They didn’t turn as they went.
units.rightText: When they went, they went in their four directions: they turned not as they went, but to the place whither the head looked they followed it; they turned not as they went.

units.leftText: Their whole body, including their backs, their hands, their wings, and the wheels, were full of eyes all around, even the wheels that the four of them had.
units.rightText: And their whole body, and their backs, and their hands, and their wings, and the wheels, were full of eyes round about, even the wheels that they four had.

units.leftText: As for the wheels, they were called in my hearing, “the whirling wheels”.
units.rightText: As for the wheels, they were called in my hearing the whirling wheels.

units.leftText: Every one of them had four faces. The first face was the face of the cherub. The second face was the face of a man. The third face was the face of a lion. The fourth was the face of an eagle.
units.rightText: And every one had four faces: the first face was the face of the cherub, and the second face was the face of a man, and the third the face of a lion, and the fourth the face of an eagle.

units.leftText: The cherubim mounted up. This is the living creature that I saw by the river Chebar.
units.rightText: And the cherubim mounted up: this is the living creature that I saw by the river Chebar.

units.leftText: When the cherubim went, the wheels went beside them; and when the cherubim lifted up their wings to mount up from the earth, the wheels also didn’t turn from beside them.
units.rightText: And when the cherubim went, the wheels went beside them; and when the cherubim lifted up their wings to mount up from the earth, the wheels also turned not from beside them.

units.leftText: When they stood, these stood. When they mounted up, these mounted up with them; for the spirit of the living creature was in them.
units.rightText: When they stood, these stood; and when they mounted up, these mounted up with them: for the spirit of the living creature was in them.

units.leftText: The LORD’s glory went out from over the threshold of the house and stood over the cherubim.
units.rightText: And the glory of Jehovah went forth from over the threshold of the house, and stood over the cherubim.

units.leftText: The cherubim lifted up their wings and mounted up from the earth in my sight when they went out, with the wheels beside them. Then they stood at the door of the east gate of the LORD’s house; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.
units.rightText: And the cherubim lifted up their wings, and mounted up from the earth in my sight when they went forth, and the wheels beside them: and they stood at the door of the east gate of Jehovah’s house; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.

units.leftText: This is the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river Chebar; and I knew that they were cherubim.
units.rightText: This is the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river Chebar; and I knew that they were cherubim.

units.leftText: Every one had four faces, and every one four wings. The likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings.
units.rightText: Every one had four faces, and every one four wings; and the likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings.

units.leftText: As for the likeness of their faces, they were the faces which I saw by the river Chebar, their appearances and themselves. They each went straight forward.
units.rightText: And as for the likeness of their faces, they were the faces which I saw by the river Chebar, their appearances and themselves; they went every one straight forward.

units.leftText: Moreover the Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the east gate of the LORD’s house, which looks eastward. Behold, twenty-five men were at the door of the gate; and I saw among them Jaazaniah the son of Azzur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, princes of the people.
units.rightText: Moreover the Spirit lifted me up, and brought me unto the east gate of Jehovah’s house, which looketh eastward: and behold, at the door of the gate five and twenty men; and I saw in the midst of them Jaazaniah the son of Azzur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, princes of the people.

units.leftText: He said to me, “Son of man, these are the men who devise iniquity, and who give wicked counsel in this city;
units.rightText: And he said unto me, Son of man, these are the men that devise iniquity, and that give wicked counsel in this city;

units.leftText: who say, ‘The time is not near to build houses. This is the cauldron, and we are the meat.’
units.rightText: that say, The time is not near to build houses: this city is the caldron, and we are the flesh.

units.leftText: Therefore prophesy against them. Prophesy, son of man.”
units.rightText: Therefore prophesy against them, prophesy, O son of man.

units.leftText: The LORD’s Spirit fell on me, and he said to me, “Speak, ‘The LORD says: “Thus you have said, house of Israel; for I know the things that come into your mind.
units.rightText: And the Spirit of Jehovah fell upon me, and he said unto me, Speak, Thus saith Jehovah: Thus have ye said, O house of Israel; for I know the things that come into your mind.

units.leftText: You have multiplied your slain in this city, and you have filled its streets with the slain.”
units.rightText: Ye have multiplied your slain in this city, and ye have filled the streets thereof with the slain.

units.leftText: “‘Therefore the Lord GOD says: “Your slain whom you have laid in the middle of it, they are the meat, and this is the cauldron; but you will be brought out of the middle of it.
units.rightText: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Your slain whom ye have laid in the midst of it, they are the flesh, and this city is the caldron; but ye shall be brought forth out of the midst of it.

units.leftText: You have feared the sword; and I will bring the sword on you,” says the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: Ye have feared the sword; and I will bring the sword upon you, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: “I will bring you out of the middle of it, and deliver you into the hands of strangers, and will execute judgments among you.
units.rightText: And I will bring you forth out of the midst thereof, and deliver you into the hands of strangers, and will execute judgments among you.

units.leftText: You will fall by the sword. I will judge you in the border of Israel. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
units.rightText: Ye shall fall by the sword; I will judge you in the border of Israel; and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: This will not be your cauldron, neither will you be the meat in the middle of it. I will judge you in the border of Israel.
units.rightText: This city shall not be your caldron, neither shall ye be the flesh in the midst thereof; I will judge you in the border of Israel;

units.leftText: You will know that I am the LORD, for you have not walked in my statutes. You have not executed my ordinances, but have done after the ordinances of the nations that are around you.”’”
units.rightText: and ye shall know that I am Jehovah: for ye have not walked in my statutes, neither have ye executed mine ordinances, but have done after the ordinances of the nations that are round about you.

units.leftText: When I prophesied, Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then I fell down on my face, and cried with a loud voice, and said, “Ah Lord GOD! Will you make a full end of the remnant of Israel?”
units.rightText: And it came to pass, when I prophesied, that Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then fell I down upon my face, and cried with a loud voice, and said, Ah Lord Jehovah! wilt thou make a full end of the remnant of Israel?

units.leftText: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, your brothers, even your brothers, the men of your relatives, and all the house of Israel, all of them, are the ones to whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, ‘Go far away from the LORD. This land has been given to us for a possession.’
units.rightText: Son of man, thy brethren, even thy brethren, the men of thy kindred, and all the house of Israel, all of them, are they unto whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, Get you far from Jehovah; unto us is this land given for a possession.

units.leftText: “Therefore say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Whereas I have removed them far off among the nations, and whereas I have scattered them among the countries, yet I will be to them a sanctuary for a little while in the countries where they have come.”’
units.rightText: Therefore say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Whereas I have removed them far off among the nations, and whereas I have scattered them among the countries, yet will I be to them a sanctuary for a little while in the countries where they are come.

units.leftText: “Therefore say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “I will gather you from the peoples, and assemble you out of the countries where you have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.”
units.rightText: Therefore say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will gather you from the peoples, and assemble you out of the countries where ye have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.

units.leftText: “‘They will come there, and they will take away all its detestable things and all its abominations from there.
units.rightText: And they shall come thither, and they shall take away all the detestable things thereof and all the abominations thereof from thence.

units.leftText: I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within them. I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them a heart of flesh,
units.rightText: And I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within you; and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them a heart of flesh;

units.leftText: that they may walk in my statutes, and keep my ordinances, and do them. They will be my people, and I will be their God.
units.rightText: that they may walk in my statutes, and keep mine ordinances, and do them: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God.

units.leftText: But as for them whose heart walks after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations, I will bring their way on their own heads,’ says the Lord GOD.”
units.rightText: But as for them whose heart walketh after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations, I will bring their way upon their own heads, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: Then the cherubim lifted up their wings, and the wheels were beside them. The glory of the God of Israel was over them above.
units.rightText: Then did the cherubim lift up their wings, and the wheels were beside them; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.

units.leftText: The LORD’s glory went up from the middle of the city, and stood on the mountain which is on the east side of the city.
units.rightText: And the glory of Jehovah went up from the midst of the city, and stood upon the mountain which is on the east side of the city.

units.leftText: The Spirit lifted me up, and brought me in the vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea, to the captives.
units.rightText: And the Spirit lifted me up, and brought me in the vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea, to them of the captivity. So the vision that I had seen went up from me.

units.leftText: Then I spoke to the captives all the things that the LORD had shown me.
units.rightText: Then I spake unto them of the captivity all the things that Jehovah had showed me.

units.leftText: The LORD’s word also came to me, saying,
units.rightText: The word of Jehovah also came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, you dwell in the middle of the rebellious house, who have eyes to see, and don’t see, who have ears to hear, and don’t hear; for they are a rebellious house.
units.rightText: Son of man, thou dwellest in the midst of the rebellious house, that have eyes to see, and see not, that have ears to hear, and hear not; for they are a rebellious house.

units.leftText: “Therefore, you son of man, prepare your baggage for moving, and move by day in their sight. You shall move from your place to another place in their sight. It may be they will consider, though they are a rebellious house.
units.rightText: Therefore, thou son of man, prepare thee stuff for removing, and remove by day in their sight; and thou shalt remove from thy place to another place in their sight: it may be they will consider, though they are a rebellious house.

units.leftText: You shall bring out your baggage by day in their sight, as baggage for moving. You shall go out yourself at evening in their sight, as when men go out into exile.
units.rightText: And thou shalt bring forth thy stuff by day in their sight, as stuff for removing; and thou shalt go forth thyself at even in their sight, as when men go forth into exile.

units.leftText: Dig through the wall in their sight, and carry your baggage out that way.
units.rightText: Dig thou through the wall in their sight, and carry out thereby.

units.leftText: In their sight you shall bear it on your shoulder, and carry it out in the dark. You shall cover your face, so that you don’t see the land, for I have set you for a sign to the house of Israel.”
units.rightText: In their sight shalt thou bear it upon thy shoulder, and carry it forth in the dark; thou shalt cover thy face, that thou see not the land: for I have set thee for a sign unto the house of Israel.

units.leftText: I did so as I was commanded. I brought out my baggage by day, as baggage for moving, and in the evening I dug through the wall with my hand. I brought it out in the dark, and bore it on my shoulder in their sight.
units.rightText: And I did so as I was commanded: I brought forth my stuff by day, as stuff for removing, and in the even I digged through the wall with my hand; I brought it forth in the dark, and bare it upon my shoulder in their sight.

units.leftText: In the morning, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And in the morning came the word of Jehovah unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, hasn’t the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said to you, ‘What are you doing?’
units.rightText: Son of man, hath not the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said unto thee, What doest thou?

units.leftText: “Say to them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “This burden concerns the prince in Jerusalem, and all the house of Israel among whom they are.”’
units.rightText: Say thou unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: This burden concerneth the prince in Jerusalem, and all the house of Israel among whom they are.

units.leftText: “Say, ‘I am your sign. As I have done, so will it be done to them. They will go into exile, into captivity.
units.rightText: Say, I am your sign: like as I have done, so shall it be done unto them; they shall go into exile, into captivity.

units.leftText: “‘The prince who is among them will bear his baggage on his shoulder in the dark, and will go out. They will dig through the wall to carry things out that way. He will cover his face, because he will not see the land with his eyes.
units.rightText: And the prince that is among them shall bear upon his shoulder in the dark, and shall go forth: they shall dig through the wall to carry out thereby: he shall cover his face, because he shall not see the land with his eyes.

units.leftText: I will also spread my net on him, and he will be taken in my snare. I will bring him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldeans; yet he will not see it, though he will die there.
