units.rightText: and say to the forest of the South, Hear the word of Jehovah: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Behold, I will kindle a fire in thee, and it shall devour every green tree in thee, and every dry tree: the flaming flame shall not be quenched, and all faces from the south to the north shall be burnt thereby.

units.leftText: All flesh will see that I, the LORD, have kindled it. It will not be quenched.”’”
units.rightText: And all flesh shall see that I, Jehovah, have kindled it; it shall not be quenched.

units.leftText: Then I said, “Ah Lord GOD! They say of me, ‘Isn’t he a speaker of parables?’”
units.rightText: Then said I, Ah Lord Jehovah! they say of me, Is he not a speaker of parables?

units.leftText: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, set your face toward Jerusalem, and preach toward the sanctuaries, and prophesy against the land of Israel.
units.rightText: Son of man, set thy face toward Jerusalem, and drop thy word toward the sanctuaries, and prophesy against the land of Israel;

units.leftText: Tell the land of Israel, ‘The LORD says: “Behold, I am against you, and will draw my sword out of its sheath, and will cut off from you the righteous and the wicked.
units.rightText: and say to the land of Israel, Thus saith Jehovah: Behold, I am against thee, and will draw forth my sword out of its sheath, and will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked.

units.leftText: Seeing then that I will cut off from you the righteous and the wicked, therefore my sword will go out of its sheath against all flesh from the south to the north.
units.rightText: Seeing then that I will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked, therefore shall my sword go forth out of its sheath against all flesh from the south to the north:

units.leftText: All flesh will know that I, the LORD, have drawn my sword out of its sheath. It will not return any more.”’
units.rightText: and all flesh shall know that I, Jehovah, have drawn forth my sword out of its sheath; it shall not return any more.

units.leftText: “Therefore sigh, you son of man. You shall sigh before their eyes with a broken heart and with bitterness.
units.rightText: Sigh therefore, thou son of man; with the breaking of thy loins and with bitterness shalt thou sigh before their eyes.
leftNotes: 21:6 literally, the breaking of your thighs

units.leftText: It shall be, when they ask you, ‘Why do you sigh?’ that you shall say, ‘Because of the news, for it comes! Every heart will melt, all hands will be feeble, every spirit will faint, and all knees will be weak as water. Behold, it comes, and it shall be done, says the Lord GOD.’”
units.rightText: And it shall be, when they say unto thee, Wherefore sighest thou? that thou shalt say, Because of the tidings, for it cometh; and every heart shall melt, and all hands shall be feeble, and every spirit shall faint, and all knees shall be weak as water: behold, it cometh, and it shall be done, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, prophesy, and say, ‘The LORD says:
units.rightText: Son of man, prophesy, and say, Thus saith Jehovah: Say, A sword, a sword, it is sharpened, and also furbished;

units.leftText: It is sharpened that it may make a slaughter.
units.rightText: it is sharpened that it may make a slaughter; it is furbished that it may be as lightning: shall we then make mirth? the rod of my son, it contemneth every tree.

units.leftText: It is given to be polished,
units.rightText: And it is given to be furbished, that it may be handled: the sword, it is sharpened, yea, it is furbished, to give it into the hand of the slayer.

units.leftText: Cry and wail, son of man;
units.rightText: Cry and wail, son of man; for it is upon my people, it is upon all the princes of Israel: they are delivered over to the sword with my people; smite therefore upon thy thigh.

units.leftText: “For there is a trial. What if even the rod that condemns will be no more?” says the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: For there is a trial; and what if even the rod that contemneth shall be no more? saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: “You therefore, son of man, prophesy,
units.rightText: Thou therefore, son of man, prophesy, and smite thy hands together; and let the sword be doubled the third time, the sword of the deadly wounded: it is the sword of the great one that is deadly wounded, which entereth into their chambers.

units.leftText: I have set the threatening sword against all their gates,
units.rightText: I have set the threatening sword against all their gates, that their heart may melt, and their stumblings be multiplied: ah! it is made as lightning, it is pointed for slaughter.

units.leftText: Gather yourselves together.
units.rightText: Gather thee together, go to the right, set thyself in array, go to the left, whithersoever thy face is set.

units.leftText: I will also strike my hands together,
units.rightText: I will also smite my hands together, and I will cause my wrath to rest: I, Jehovah, have spoken it.

units.leftText: The LORD’s word came to me again, saying,
units.rightText: The word of Jehovah came unto me again, saying,

units.leftText: “Also, you son of man, appoint two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may come. They both will come out of one land, and mark out a place. Mark it out at the head of the way to the city.
units.rightText: Also, thou son of man, appoint thee two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may come; they twain shall come forth out of one land: and mark out a place, mark it out at the head of the way to the city.

units.leftText: You shall appoint a way for the sword to come to Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and to Judah in Jerusalem the fortified.
units.rightText: Thou shalt appoint a way for the sword to come to Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and to Judah in Jerusalem the fortified.

units.leftText: For the king of Babylon stood at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination. He shook the arrows back and forth. He consulted the teraphim. He looked in the liver.
units.rightText: For the king of Babylon stood at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination: he shook the arrows to and fro, he consulted the teraphim, he looked in the liver.
leftNotes: 21:21 teraphim were household idols that may have been associated with inheritance rights to the household property.

units.leftText: In his right hand was the lot for Jerusalem, to set battering rams, to open the mouth in the slaughter, to lift up the voice with shouting, to set battering rams against the gates, to cast up mounds, and to build forts.
units.rightText: In his right hand was the divination for Jerusalem, to set battering rams, to open the mouth in the slaughter, to lift up the voice with shouting, to set battering rams against the gates, to cast up mounds, to build forts.

units.leftText: It will be to them as a false divination in their sight, who have sworn oaths to them; but he brings iniquity to memory, that they may be taken.
units.rightText: And it shall be unto them as a false divination in their sight, who have sworn oaths unto them; but he bringeth iniquity to remembrance, that they may be taken.

units.leftText: “Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Because you have caused your iniquity to be remembered, in that your transgressions are uncovered, so that in all your doings your sins appear; because you have come to memory, you will be taken with the hand.
units.rightText: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because ye have made your iniquity to be remembered, in that your transgressions are uncovered, so that in all your doings your sins do appear; because that ye are come to remembrance, ye shall be taken with the hand.

units.leftText: “‘You, deadly wounded wicked one, the prince of Israel, whose day has come, in the time of the iniquity of the end,
units.rightText: And thou, O deadly wounded wicked one, the prince of Israel, whose day is come, in the time of the iniquity of the end,

units.leftText: the Lord GOD says: “Remove the turban, and take off the crown. This will not be as it was. Exalt that which is low, and humble that which is high.
units.rightText: thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Remove the mitre, and take off the crown; this shall be no more the same; exalt that which is low, and abase that which is high.

units.leftText: I will overturn, overturn, overturn it. This also will be no more, until he comes whose right it is; and I will give it.”’
units.rightText: I will overturn, overturn, overturn it: this also shall be no more, until he come whose right it is; and I will give it him.

units.leftText: “You, son of man, prophesy and say, ‘The Lord GOD says this concerning the children of Ammon, and concerning their reproach:
units.rightText: And thou, son of man, prophesy, and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah concerning the children of Ammon, and concerning their reproach; and say thou, A sword, a sword is drawn, for the slaughter it is furbished, to cause it to devour, that it may be as lightning;

units.leftText: while they see for you false visions,
units.rightText: while they see for thee false visions, while they divine lies unto thee, to lay thee upon the necks of the wicked that are deadly wounded, whose day is come in the time of the iniquity of the end.

units.leftText: Cause it to return into its sheath.
units.rightText: Cause it to return into its sheath. In the place where thou wast created, in the land of thy birth, will I judge thee.

units.leftText: I will pour out my indignation on you.
units.rightText: And I will pour out mine indignation upon thee; I will blow upon thee with the fire of my wrath; and I will deliver thee into the hand of brutish men, skilful to destroy.

units.leftText: You will be for fuel to the fire.
units.rightText: Thou shalt be for fuel to the fire; thy blood shall be in the midst of the land; thou shalt be no more remembered: for I, Jehovah, have spoken it.

units.leftText: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: Moreover the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “You, son of man, will you judge? Will you judge the bloody city? Then cause her to know all her abominations.
units.rightText: And thou, son of man, wilt thou judge, wilt thou judge the bloody city? then cause her to know all her abominations.

units.leftText: You shall say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “A city that sheds blood within herself, that her time may come, and that makes idols against herself to defile her!
units.rightText: And thou shalt say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: A city that sheddeth blood in the midst of her, that her time may come, and that maketh idols against herself to defile her!

units.leftText: You have become guilty in your blood that you have shed, and are defiled in your idols which you have made! You have caused your days to draw near, and have come to the end of your years. Therefore I have made you a reproach to the nations, and a mocking to all the countries.
units.rightText: Thou art become guilty in thy blood that thou hast shed, and art defiled in thine idols which thou hast made; and thou hast caused thy days to draw near, and art come even unto thy years: therefore have I made thee a reproach unto the nations, and a mocking to all the countries.

units.leftText: Those who are near and those who are far from you will mock you, you infamous one, full of tumult.
units.rightText: Those that are near, and those that are far from thee, shall mock thee, thou infamous one and full of tumult.

units.leftText: “‘“Behold, the princes of Israel, everyone according to his power, have been in you to shed blood.
units.rightText: Behold, the princes of Israel, every one according to his power, have been in thee to shed blood.

units.leftText: In you have they treated father and mother with contempt. Among you they have oppressed the foreigner. In you they have wronged the fatherless and the widow.
units.rightText: In thee have they set light by father and mother; in the midst of thee have they dealt by oppression with the sojourner; in thee have they wronged the fatherless and the widow.
leftNotes: 22:7 Literally, made light of father and mother.

units.leftText: You have despised my holy things, and have profaned my Sabbaths.
units.rightText: Thou hast despised my holy things, and hast profaned my sabbaths.

units.leftText: Slanderous men have been in you to shed blood. In you they have eaten on the mountains. They have committed lewdness among you.
units.rightText: Slanderous men have been in thee to shed blood; and in thee they have eaten upon the mountains: in the midst of thee they have committed lewdness.

units.leftText: In you have they uncovered their fathers’ nakedness. In you have they humbled her who was unclean in her impurity.
units.rightText: In thee have they uncovered their fathers’ nakedness; in thee have they humbled her that was unclean in her impurity.

units.leftText: One has committed abomination with his neighbor’s wife, and another has lewdly defiled his daughter-in-law. Another in you has humbled his sister, his father’s daughter.
units.rightText: And one hath committed abomination with his neighbor’s wife; and another hath lewdly defiled his daughter-in-law; and another in thee hath humbled his sister, his father’s daughter.

units.leftText: In you have they taken bribes to shed blood. You have taken interest and increase, and you have greedily gained of your neighbors by oppression, and have forgotten me,” says the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: In thee have they taken bribes to shed blood; thou hast taken interest and increase, and thou hast greedily gained of thy neighbors by oppression, and hast forgotten me, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: “‘“Behold, therefore I have struck my hand at your dishonest gain which you have made, and at the blood which has been shed within you.
units.rightText: Behold, therefore, I have smitten my hand at thy dishonest gain which thou hast made, and at thy blood which hath been in the midst of thee.

units.leftText: Can your heart endure, or can your hands be strong, in the days that I will deal with you? I, the LORD, have spoken it, and will do it.
units.rightText: Can thy heart endure, or can thy hands be strong, in the days that I shall deal with thee? I, Jehovah, have spoken it, and will do it.

units.leftText: I will scatter you among the nations, and disperse you through the countries. I will purge your filthiness out of you.
units.rightText: And I will scatter thee among the nations, and disperse thee through the countries; and I will consume thy filthiness out of thee.

units.leftText: You will be profaned in yourself in the sight of the nations. Then you will know that I am the LORD.”’”
units.rightText: And thou shalt be profaned in thyself, in the sight of the nations; and thou shalt know that I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, the house of Israel has become dross to me. All of them are bronze, tin, iron, and lead in the middle of the furnace. They are the dross of silver.
units.rightText: Son of man, the house of Israel is become dross unto me: all of them are brass and tin and iron and lead, in the midst of the furnace; they are the dross of silver.

units.leftText: Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Because you have all become dross, therefore, behold, I will gather you into the middle of Jerusalem.
units.rightText: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because ye are all become dross, therefore, behold, I will gather you into the midst of Jerusalem.

units.leftText: As they gather silver, bronze, iron, lead, and tin into the middle of the furnace, to blow the fire on it, to melt it, so I will gather you in my anger and in my wrath, and I will lay you there and melt you.
units.rightText: As they gather silver and brass and iron and lead and tin into the midst of the furnace, to blow the fire upon it, to melt it; so will I gather you in mine anger and in my wrath, and I will lay you there, and melt you.

units.leftText: Yes, I will gather you, and blow on you with the fire of my wrath, and you will be melted in the middle of it.
units.rightText: Yea, I will gather you, and blow upon you with the fire of my wrath, and ye shall be melted in the midst thereof.

units.leftText: As silver is melted in the middle of the furnace, so you will be melted in the middle of it; and you will know that I, the LORD, have poured out my wrath on you.’”
units.rightText: As silver is melted in the midst of the furnace, so shall ye be melted in the midst thereof; and ye shall know that I, Jehovah, have poured out my wrath upon you.

units.leftText: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, tell her, ‘You are a land that is not cleansed nor rained on in the day of indignation.’
units.rightText: Son of man, say unto her, Thou art a land that is not cleansed, nor rained upon in the day of indignation.

units.leftText: There is a conspiracy of her prophets within it, like a roaring lion ravening the prey. They have devoured souls. They take treasure and precious things. They have made many widows within it.
units.rightText: There is a conspiracy of her prophets in the midst thereof, like a roaring lion ravening the prey: they have devoured souls; they take treasure and precious things; they have made her widows many in the midst thereof.

units.leftText: Her priests have done violence to my law and have profaned my holy things. They have made no distinction between the holy and the common, neither have they caused men to discern between the unclean and the clean, and have hidden their eyes from my Sabbaths. So I am profaned among them.
units.rightText: Her priests have done violence to my law, and have profaned my holy things: they have made no distinction between the holy and the common, neither have they caused men to discern between the unclean and the clean, and have hid their eyes from my sabbaths, and I am profaned among them.

units.leftText: Her princes within it are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood and to destroy souls, that they may get dishonest gain.
units.rightText: Her princes in the midst thereof are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood, and to destroy souls, that they may get dishonest gain.

units.leftText: Her prophets have plastered for them with whitewash, seeing false visions, and divining lies to them, saying, ‘The Lord GOD says,’ when the LORD has not spoken.
units.rightText: And her prophets have daubed for them with untempered mortar, seeing false visions, and divining lies unto them, saying, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah, when Jehovah hath not spoken.

units.leftText: The people of the land have used oppression and exercised robbery. Yes, they have troubled the poor and needy, and have oppressed the foreigner wrongfully.
units.rightText: The people of the land have used oppression, and exercised robbery; yea, they have vexed the poor and needy, and have oppressed the sojourner wrongfully.

units.leftText: “I sought for a man among them who would build up the wall and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I would not destroy it; but I found no one.
units.rightText: And I sought for a man among them, that should build up the wall, and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I should not destroy it; but I found none.

units.leftText: Therefore I have poured out my indignation on them. I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath. I have brought their own way on their heads,” says the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: Therefore have I poured out mine indignation upon them; I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath: their own way have I brought upon their heads, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: The LORD’s word came again to me, saying,
units.rightText: The word of Jehovah came again unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, there were two women, the daughters of one mother.
units.rightText: Son of man, there were two women, the daughters of one mother:

units.leftText: They played the prostitute in Egypt. They played the prostitute in their youth. Their breasts were fondled there, and their youthful nipples were caressed there.
units.rightText: and they played the harlot in Egypt; they played the harlot in their youth; there were their breasts pressed, and there was handled the bosom of their virginity.

units.leftText: Their names were Oholah the elder, and Oholibah her sister. They became mine, and they bore sons and daughters. As for their names, Samaria is Oholah, and Jerusalem Oholibah.
units.rightText: And the names of them were Oholah the elder, and Oholibah her sister: and they became mine, and they bare sons and daughters. And as for their names, Samaria is Oholah, and Jerusalem Oholibah.

units.leftText: “Oholah played the prostitute when she was mine. She doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians her neighbors,
units.rightText: And Oholah played the harlot when she was mine; and she doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians her neighbors,

units.leftText: who were clothed with blue—governors and rulers, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding on horses.
units.rightText: who were clothed with blue, governors and rulers, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding upon horses.

units.leftText: She gave herself as a prostitute to them, all of them the choicest men of Assyria. She defiled herself with the idols of whomever she lusted after.
units.rightText: And she bestowed her whoredoms upon them, the choicest men of Assyria all of them; and on whomsoever she doted, with all their idols she defiled herself.

units.leftText: She hasn’t left her prostitution since leaving Egypt; for in her youth they lay with her. They caressed her youthful nipples and they poured out their prostitution on her.
units.rightText: Neither hath she left her whoredoms since the days of Egypt; for in her youth they lay with her, and they handled the bosom of her virginity; and they poured out their whoredom upon her.

units.leftText: “Therefore I delivered her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians on whom she doted.
units.rightText: Wherefore I delivered her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians, upon whom she doted.

units.leftText: These uncovered her nakedness. They took her sons and her daughters, and they killed her with the sword. She became a byword among women; for they executed judgments on her.
units.rightText: These uncovered her nakedness; they took her sons and her daughters; and her they slew with the sword: and she became a byword among women; for they executed judgments upon her.

units.leftText: “Her sister Oholibah saw this, yet she was more corrupt in her lusting than she, and in her prostitution which was more depraved than the prostitution of her sister.
units.rightText: And her sister Oholibah saw this, yet was she more corrupt in her doting than she, and in her whoredoms which were more than the whoredoms of her sister.

units.leftText: She lusted after the Assyrians, governors and rulers—her neighbors, clothed most gorgeously, horsemen riding on horses, all of them desirable young men.
units.rightText: She doted upon the Assyrians, governors and rulers, her neighbors, clothed most gorgeously, horsemen riding upon horses, all of them desirable young men.

units.leftText: I saw that she was defiled. They both went the same way.
units.rightText: And I saw that she was defiled; they both took one way.

units.leftText: “She increased her prostitution; for she saw men portrayed on the wall, the images of the Chaldeans portrayed with red,
units.rightText: And she increased her whoredoms; for she saw men portrayed upon the wall, the images of the Chaldeans portrayed with vermilion,

units.leftText: dressed with belts on their waists, with flowing turbans on their heads, all of them looking like princes, after the likeness of the Babylonians in Chaldea, the land of their birth.
units.rightText: girded with girdles upon their loins, with flowing turbans upon their heads, all of them princes to look upon, after the likeness of the Babylonians in Chaldea, the land of their nativity.

units.leftText: As soon as she saw them, she lusted after them and sent messengers to them into Chaldea.
units.rightText: And as soon as she saw them she doted upon them, and sent messengers unto them into Chaldea.

units.leftText: The Babylonians came to her into the bed of love, and they defiled her with their prostitution. She was polluted with them, and her soul was alienated from them.
units.rightText: And the Babylonians came to her into the bed of love, and they defiled her with their whoredom, and she was polluted with them, and her soul was alienated from them.

units.leftText: So she uncovered her prostitution and uncovered her nakedness. Then my soul was alienated from her, just like my soul was alienated from her sister.
units.rightText: So she uncovered her whoredoms, and uncovered her nakedness: then my soul was alienated from her, like as my soul was alienated from her sister.

units.leftText: Yet she multiplied her prostitution, remembering the days of her youth, in which she had played the prostitute in the land of Egypt.
units.rightText: Yet she multiplied her whoredoms, remembering the days of her youth, wherein she had played the harlot in the land of Egypt.

units.leftText: She lusted after their lovers, whose flesh is as the flesh of donkeys, and whose issue is like the issue of horses.
units.rightText: And she doted upon their paramours, whose flesh is as the flesh of asses, and whose issue is like the issue of horses.

units.leftText: Thus you called to memory the lewdness of your youth, in the caressing of your nipples by the Egyptians because of your youthful breasts.
units.rightText: Thus thou calledst to remembrance the lewdness of thy youth, in the handling of thy bosom by the Egyptians for the breasts of thy youth.

units.leftText: “Therefore, Oholibah, the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I will raise up your lovers against you, from whom your soul is alienated, and I will bring them against you on every side:
units.rightText: Therefore, O Oholibah, thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will raise up thy lovers against thee, from whom thy soul is alienated, and I will bring them against thee on every side:

units.leftText: the Babylonians and all the Chaldeans, Pekod, Shoa, Koa, and all the Assyrians with them; all of them desirable young men, governors and rulers, princes and men of renown, all of them riding on horses.
units.rightText: the Babylonians and all the Chaldeans, Pekod and Shoa and Koa, and all the Assyrians with them; desirable young men, governors and rulers all of them, princes and men of renown, all of them riding upon horses.

units.leftText: They will come against you with weapons, chariots, and wagons, and with a company of peoples. They will set themselves against you with buckler, shield, and helmet all around. I will commit the judgment to them, and they will judge you according to their judgments.
units.rightText: And they shall come against thee with weapons, chariots, and wagons, and with a company of peoples; they shall set themselves against thee with buckler and shield and helmet round about: and I will commit the judgment unto them, and they shall judge thee according to their judgments.

units.leftText: I will set my jealousy against you, and they will deal with you in fury. They will take away your nose and your ears. Your remnant will fall by the sword. They will take your sons and your daughters; and the rest of you will be devoured by the fire.
units.rightText: And I will set my jealousy against thee, and they shall deal with thee in fury; they shall take away thy nose and thine ears; and thy residue shall fall by the sword: they shall take thy sons and thy daughters; and thy residue shall be devoured by the fire.

units.leftText: They will also strip you of your clothes and take away your beautiful jewels.
units.rightText: They shall also strip thee of thy clothes, and take away thy fair jewels.

units.leftText: Thus I will make your lewdness to cease from you, and remove your prostitution from the land of Egypt, so that you will not lift up your eyes to them, nor remember Egypt any more.’
units.rightText: Thus will I make thy lewdness to cease from thee, and thy whoredom brought from the land of Egypt; so that thou shalt not lift up thine eyes unto them, nor remember Egypt any more.

units.leftText: “For the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I will deliver you into the hand of them whom you hate, into the hand of them from whom your soul is alienated.
units.rightText: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will deliver thee into the hand of them whom thou hatest, into the hand of them from whom thy soul is alienated;

units.leftText: They will deal with you in hatred, and will take away all your labor, and will leave you naked and bare. The nakedness of your prostitution will be uncovered, both your lewdness and your prostitution.
units.rightText: and they shall deal with thee in hatred, and shall take away all thy labor, and shall leave thee naked and bare; and the nakedness of thy whoredoms shall be uncovered, both thy lewdness and thy whoredoms.

units.leftText: These things will be done to you because you have played the prostitute after the nations, and because you are polluted with their idols.
units.rightText: These things shall be done unto thee, for that thou hast played the harlot after the nations, and because thou art polluted with their idols.

units.leftText: You have walked in the way of your sister; therefore I will give her cup into your hand.’
units.rightText: Thou hast walked in the way of thy sister; therefore will I give her cup into thy hand.

units.leftText: “The Lord GOD says:
units.rightText: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Thou shalt drink of thy sister’s cup, which is deep and large; thou shalt be laughed to scorn and had in derision; it containeth much.

units.leftText: You will be filled with drunkenness and sorrow,
units.rightText: Thou shalt be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, with the cup of astonishment and desolation, with the cup of thy sister Samaria.

units.leftText: You will even drink it and drain it out.
units.rightText: Thou shalt even drink it and drain it out, and thou shalt gnaw the sherds thereof, and shalt tear thy breasts; for I have spoken it, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: “Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Because you have forgotten me and cast me behind your back, therefore you also bear your lewdness and your prostitution.’”
units.rightText: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because thou hast forgotten me, and cast me behind thy back, therefore bear thou also thy lewdness and thy whoredoms.

units.leftText: The LORD said moreover to me: “Son of man, will you judge Oholah and Oholibah? Then declare to them their abominations.
units.rightText: Jehovah said moreover unto me: Son of man, wilt thou judge Oholah and Oholibah? then declare unto them their abominations.

units.leftText: For they have committed adultery, and blood is in their hands. They have committed adultery with their idols. They have also caused their sons, whom they bore to me, to pass through the fire to them to be devoured.
units.rightText: For they have committed adultery, and blood is in their hands; and with their idols have they committed adultery; and they have also caused their sons, whom they bare unto me, to pass through the fire unto them to be devoured.

units.leftText: Moreover this they have done to me: they have defiled my sanctuary in the same day, and have profaned my Sabbaths.
units.rightText: Moreover this they have done unto me: they have defiled my sanctuary in the same day, and have profaned my sabbaths.

units.leftText: For when they had slain their children to their idols, then they came the same day into my sanctuary to profane it; and behold, they have done this in the middle of my house.
units.rightText: For when they had slain their children to their idols, then they came the same day into my sanctuary to profane it; and, lo, thus have they done in the midst of my house.

units.leftText: “Furthermore you sisters have sent for men who come from far away, to whom a messenger was sent, and behold, they came; for whom you washed yourself, painted your eyes, decorated yourself with ornaments,
units.rightText: And furthermore ye have sent for men that come from far, unto whom a messenger was sent, and, lo, they came; for whom thou didst wash thyself, paint thine eyes, and deck thyself with ornaments,

units.leftText: and sat on a stately bed, with a table prepared before it, whereupon you set my incense and my oil.
units.rightText: and sit upon a stately bed, with a table prepared before it, whereupon thou didst set mine incense and mine oil.

units.leftText: “The voice of a multitude being at ease was with her. With men of the common sort were brought drunkards from the wilderness; and they put bracelets on their hands, and beautiful crowns on their heads.
units.rightText: And the voice of a multitude being at ease was with her: and with men of the common sort were brought drunkards from the wilderness; and they put bracelets upon the hands of them twain, and beautiful crowns upon their heads.

units.leftText: Then I said of her who was old in adulteries, ‘Now they will play the prostitute with her, and she with them.’
units.rightText: Then said I of her that was old in adulteries, Now will they play the harlot with her, and she with them.

units.leftText: They went in to her, as they go in to a prostitute. So they went in to Oholah and to Oholibah, the lewd women.
units.rightText: And they went in unto her, as they go in unto a harlot: so went they in unto Oholah and unto Oholibah, the lewd women.

units.leftText: Righteous men will judge them with the judgment of adulteresses and with the judgment of women who shed blood, because they are adulteresses, and blood is in their hands.
units.rightText: And righteous men, they shall judge them with the judgment of adulteresses, and with the judgment of women that shed blood; because they are adulteresses, and blood is in their hands.

units.leftText: “For the Lord GOD says: ‘I will bring up a mob against them, and will give them to be tossed back and forth and robbed.
units.rightText: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will bring up a company against them, and will give them to be tossed to and fro and robbed.

units.leftText: The company will stone them with stones and dispatch them with their swords. They will kill their sons and their daughters, and burn up their houses with fire.
units.rightText: And the company shall stone them with stones, and despatch them with their swords; they shall slay their sons and their daughters, and burn up their houses with fire.

units.leftText: “‘Thus I will cause lewdness to cease out of the land, that all women may be taught not to be lewd like you.
units.rightText: Thus will I cause lewdness to cease out of the land, that all women may be taught not to do after your lewdness.

units.leftText: They will recompense your lewdness on you, and you will bear the sins of your idols. Then you will know that I am the Lord GOD.’”
units.rightText: And they shall recompense your lewdness upon you, and ye shall bear the sins of your idols; and ye shall know that I am the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: Again, in the ninth year, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: Again, in the ninth year, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, write the name of the day, this same day. The king of Babylon drew close to Jerusalem this same day.
units.rightText: Son of man, write thee the name of the day, even of this selfsame day: the king of Babylon drew close unto Jerusalem this selfsame day.

units.leftText: Utter a parable to the rebellious house, and tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says,
units.rightText: And utter a parable unto the rebellious house, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Set on the caldron, set it on, and also pour water into it:

units.leftText: Gather its pieces into it,
units.rightText: gather the pieces thereof into it, even every good piece, the thigh, and the shoulder; fill it with the choice bones.

units.leftText: Take the choice of the flock,
units.rightText: Take the choice of the flock, and also a pile of wood for the bones under the caldron; make it boil well; yea, let the bones thereof be boiled in the midst of it.

units.leftText: “‘Therefore the Lord GOD says:
units.rightText: Wherefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Woe to the bloody city, to the caldron whose rust is therein, and whose rust is not gone out of it! take out of it piece after piece; No lot is fallen upon it.

units.leftText: “‘“For the blood she shed is in the middle of her.
units.rightText: For her blood is in the midst of her; she set it upon the bare rock; she poured it not upon the ground, to cover it with dust.

units.leftText: That it may cause wrath to come up to take vengeance,
units.rightText: That it may cause wrath to come up to take vengeance, I have set her blood upon the bare rock, that it should not be covered.

units.leftText: “‘Therefore the Lord GOD says:
units.rightText: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Woe to the bloody city! I also will make the pile great.

units.leftText: Heap on the wood.
units.rightText: Heap on the wood, make the fire hot, boil well the flesh, and make thick the broth, and let the bones be burned.

units.leftText: Then set it empty on its coals,
units.rightText: Then set it empty upon the coals thereof, that it may be hot, and the brass thereof may burn, and that the filthiness of it may be molten in it, that the rust of it may be consumed.

units.leftText: She is weary with toil;
units.rightText: She hath wearied herself with toil; yet her great rust goeth not forth out of her; her rust goeth not forth by fire.

units.leftText: “‘“In your filthiness is lewdness. Because I have cleansed you and you weren’t cleansed, you won’t be cleansed from your filthiness any more, until I have caused my wrath toward you to rest.
units.rightText: In thy filthiness is lewdness: because I have cleansed thee and thou wast not cleansed, thou shalt not be cleansed from thy filthiness any more, till I have caused my wrath toward thee to rest.

units.leftText: “‘“I, the LORD, have spoken it. It will happen, and I will do it. I won’t go back. I won’t spare. I won’t repent. According to your ways and according to your doings, they will judge you,” says the Lord GOD.’”
units.rightText: I, Jehovah, have spoken it: it shall come to pass, and I will do it: I will not go back, neither will I spare, neither will I repent; according to thy ways, and according to thy doings, shall they judge thee, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: Also the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: Also the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, behold, I will take away from you the desire of your eyes with one stroke; yet you shall neither mourn nor weep, neither shall your tears run down.
units.rightText: Son of man, behold, I take away from thee the desire of thine eyes with a stroke: yet thou shalt neither mourn nor weep, neither shall thy tears run down.

units.leftText: Sigh, but not aloud. Make no mourning for the dead. Bind your headdress on you, and put your sandals on your feet. Don’t cover your lips, and don’t eat mourner’s bread.”
units.rightText: Sigh, but not aloud, make no mourning for the dead; bind thy headtire upon thee, and put thy shoes upon thy feet, and cover not thy lips, and eat not the bread of men.

units.leftText: So I spoke to the people in the morning, and at evening my wife died. So I did in the morning as I was commanded.
units.rightText: So I spake unto the people in the morning; and at even my wife died; and I did in the morning as I was commanded.

units.leftText: The people asked me, “Won’t you tell us what these things mean to us, that you act like this?”
units.rightText: And the people said unto me, Wilt thou not tell us what these things are to us, that thou doest so?

units.leftText: Then I said to them, “The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: Then I said unto them, The word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: ‘Speak to the house of Israel, “The Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I will profane my sanctuary, the pride of your power, the desire of your eyes, and that which your soul pities; and your sons and your daughters whom you have left behind will fall by the sword.
units.rightText: Speak unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will profane my sanctuary, the pride of your power, the desire of your eyes, and that which your soul pitieth; and your sons and your daughters whom ye have left behind shall fall by the sword.

units.leftText: You will do as I have done. You won’t cover your lips or eat mourner’s bread.
units.rightText: And ye shall do as I have done: ye shall not cover your lips, nor eat the bread of men.

units.leftText: Your turbans will be on your heads, and your sandals on your feet. You won’t mourn or weep; but you will pine away in your iniquities, and moan one toward another.
units.rightText: And your tires shall be upon your heads, and your shoes upon your feet: ye shall not mourn nor weep; but ye shall pine away in your iniquities, and moan one toward another.

units.leftText: Thus Ezekiel will be a sign to you; according to all that he has done, you will do. When this comes, then you will know that I am the Lord GOD.’”’”
units.rightText: Thus shall Ezekiel be unto you a sign; according to all that he hath done shall ye do: when this cometh, then shall ye know that I am the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: “You, son of man, shouldn’t it be in the day when I take from them their strength, the joy of their glory, the desire of their eyes, and that whereupon they set their heart—their sons and their daughters—
units.rightText: And thou, son of man, shall it not be in the day when I take from them their strength, the joy of their glory, the desire of their eyes, and that whereupon they set their heart, their sons and their daughters,

units.leftText: that in that day he who escapes will come to you, to cause you to hear it with your ears?
units.rightText: that in that day he that escapeth shall come unto thee, to cause thee to hear it with thine ears?

units.leftText: In that day your mouth will be opened to him who has escaped, and you will speak and be no more mute. So you will be a sign to them. Then they will know that I am the LORD.”
units.rightText: In that day shall thy mouth be opened to him that is escaped, and thou shalt speak, and be no more dumb: so shalt thou be a sign unto them; and they shall know that I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, set your face toward the children of Ammon, and prophesy against them.
units.rightText: Son of man, set thy face toward the children of Ammon, and prophesy against them:

units.leftText: Tell the children of Ammon, ‘Hear the word of the Lord GOD! The Lord GOD says, “Because you said, ‘Aha!’ against my sanctuary when it was profaned, and against the land of Israel when it was made desolate, and against the house of Judah when they went into captivity,
units.rightText: and say unto the children of Ammon, Hear the word of the Lord Jehovah: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Because thou saidst, Aha, against my sanctuary, when it was profaned; and against the land of Israel, when it was made desolate; and against the house of Judah, when they went into captivity:

units.leftText: therefore, behold, I will deliver you to the children of the east for a possession. They will set their encampments in you and make their dwellings in you. They will eat your fruit and they will drink your milk.
units.rightText: therefore, behold, I will deliver thee to the children of the east for a possession, and they shall set their encampments in thee, and make their dwellings in thee; they shall eat thy fruit, and they shall drink thy milk.

units.leftText: I will make Rabbah a stable for camels and the children of Ammon a resting place for flocks. Then you will know that I am the LORD.”
units.rightText: And I will make Rabbah a stable for camels, and the children of Ammon a couching-place for flocks: and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: For the Lord GOD says: “Because you have clapped your hands, stamped with the feet, and rejoiced with all the contempt of your soul against the land of Israel,
units.rightText: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because thou hast clapped thy hands, and stamped with the feet, and rejoiced with all the despite of thy soul against the land of Israel;

units.leftText: therefore, behold, I have stretched out my hand on you, and will deliver you for a plunder to the nations. I will cut you off from the peoples, and I will cause you to perish out of the countries. I will destroy you. Then you will know that I am the LORD.”
units.rightText: therefore, behold, I have stretched out my hand upon thee, and will deliver thee for a spoil to the nations; and I will cut thee off from the peoples, and I will cause thee to perish out of the countries: I will destroy thee; and thou shalt know that I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: “‘The Lord GOD says: “Because Moab and Seir say, ‘Behold, the house of Judah is like all the nations,’
units.rightText: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because that Moab and Seir do say, Behold, the house of Judah is like unto all the nations;

units.leftText: therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities which are on its frontiers, the glory of the country, Beth Jeshimoth, Baal Meon, and Kiriathaim,
units.rightText: therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities which are on his frontiers, the glory of the country, Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon, and Kiriathaim,

units.leftText: to the children of the east, to go against the children of Ammon; and I will give them for a possession, that the children of Ammon may not be remembered among the nations.
units.rightText: unto the children of the east, to go against the children of Ammon; and I will give them for a possession, that the children of Ammon may not be remembered among the nations:

units.leftText: I will execute judgments on Moab. Then they will know that I am the LORD.”
units.rightText: and I will execute judgments upon Moab; and they shall know that I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: “‘The Lord GOD says: “Because Edom has dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and has greatly offended, and taken revenge on them,”
units.rightText: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because that Edom hath dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and hath greatly offended, and revenged himself upon them;

units.leftText: therefore the Lord GOD says, “I will stretch out my hand on Edom, and will cut off man and animal from it; and I will make it desolate from Teman. They will fall by the sword even to Dedan.
units.rightText: therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah, I will stretch out my hand upon Edom, and will cut off man and beast from it; and I will make it desolate from Teman; even unto Dedan shall they fall by the sword.

units.leftText: I will lay my vengeance on Edom by the hand of my people Israel. They will do in Edom according to my anger and according to my wrath. Then they will know my vengeance,” says the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: And I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Israel; and they shall do in Edom according to mine anger and according to my wrath; and they shall know my vengeance, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: “‘The Lord GOD says: “Because the Philistines have taken revenge, and have taken vengeance with contempt of soul to destroy with perpetual hostility,”
units.rightText: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because the Philistines have dealt by revenge, and have taken vengeance with despite of soul to destroy with perpetual enmity;

units.leftText: therefore the Lord GOD says, “Behold, I will stretch out my hand on the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethites, and destroy the remnant of the sea coast.
units.rightText: therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Behold, I will stretch out my hand upon the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethites, and destroy the remnant of the sea coast.

units.leftText: I will execute great vengeance on them with wrathful rebukes. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I lay my vengeance on them.”’”
units.rightText: And I will execute great vengeance upon them with wrathful rebukes; and they shall know that I am Jehovah, when I shall lay my vengeance upon them.

units.leftText: In the eleventh year, in the first of the month, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first day of the month, that the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, because Tyre has said against Jerusalem, ‘Aha! She is broken! She who was the gateway of the peoples has been returned to me. I will be replenished, now that she is laid waste;’
units.rightText: Son of man, because that Tyre hath said against Jerusalem, Aha, she is broken that was the gate of the peoples; she is turned unto me; I shall be replenished, now that she is laid waste:

units.leftText: therefore the Lord GOD says, ‘Behold, I am against you, Tyre, and will cause many nations to come up against you, as the sea causes its waves to come up.
units.rightText: therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Behold, I am against thee, O Tyre, and will cause many nations to come up against thee, as the sea causeth its waves to come up.

units.leftText: They will destroy the walls of Tyre, and break down her towers. I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her a bare rock.
units.rightText: And they shall destroy the walls of Tyre, and break down her towers: I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her a bare rock.

units.leftText: She will be a place for the spreading of nets in the middle of the sea; for I have spoken it,’ says the Lord GOD. ‘She will become plunder for the nations.
units.rightText: She shall be a place for the spreading of nets in the midst of the sea; for I have spoken it, saith the Lord Jehovah; and she shall become a spoil to the nations.

units.leftText: Her daughters who are in the field will be slain with the sword. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’
units.rightText: And her daughters that are in the field shall be slain with the sword: and they shall know that I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: “For the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I will bring on Tyre Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, king of kings, from the north, with horses, with chariots, with horsemen, and an army with many people.
units.rightText: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will bring upon Tyre Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, king of kings, from the north, with horses, and with chariots, and with horsemen, and a company, and much people.

units.leftText: He will kill your daughters in the field with the sword. He will make forts against you, cast up a mound against you, and raise up the buckler against you.
units.rightText: He shall slay with the sword thy daughters in the field; and he shall make forts against thee, and cast up a mound against thee, and raise up the buckler against thee.

units.leftText: He will set his battering engines against your walls, and with his axes he will break down your towers.
units.rightText: And he shall set his battering engines against thy walls, and with his axes he shall break down thy towers.

units.leftText: By reason of the abundance of his horses, their dust will cover you. Your walls will shake at the noise of the horsemen, of the wagons, and of the chariots, when he enters into your gates, as men enter into a city which is broken open.
units.rightText: By reason of the abundance of his horses their dust shall cover thee: thy walls shall shake at the noise of the horsemen, and of the wagons, and of the chariots, when he shall enter into thy gates, as men enter into a city wherein is made a breach.

units.leftText: He will tread down all your streets with the hoofs of his horses. He will kill your people with the sword. The pillars of your strength will go down to the ground.
units.rightText: With the hoofs of his horses shall he tread down all thy streets; he shall slay thy people with the sword; and the pillars of thy strength shall go down to the ground.

units.leftText: They will make a plunder of your riches and make a prey of your merchandise. They will break down your walls and destroy your pleasant houses. They will lay your stones, your timber, and your dust in the middle of the waters.
units.rightText: And they shall make a spoil of thy riches, and make a prey of thy merchandise; and they shall break down thy walls, and destroy thy pleasant houses; and they shall lay thy stones and thy timber and thy dust in the midst of the waters.

units.leftText: I will cause the noise of your songs to cease. The sound of your harps won’t be heard any more.
units.rightText: And I will cause the noise of thy songs to cease; and the sound of thy harps shall be no more heard.

units.leftText: I will make you a bare rock. You will be a place for the spreading of nets. You will be built no more; for I the LORD have spoken it,’ says the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: And I will make thee a bare rock; thou shalt be a place for the spreading of nets; thou shalt be built no more: for I Jehovah have spoken it, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: “The Lord GOD says to Tyre: ‘Won’t the islands shake at the sound of your fall, when the wounded groan, when the slaughter is made within you?
units.rightText: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah to Tyre: shall not the isles shake at the sound of thy fall, when the wounded groan, when the slaughter is made in the midst of thee?

units.leftText: Then all the princes of the sea will come down from their thrones, and lay aside their robes, and strip off their embroidered garments. They will clothe themselves with trembling. They will sit on the ground, and will tremble every moment, and be astonished at you.
units.rightText: Then all the princes of the sea shall come down from their thrones, and lay aside their robes, and strip off their broidered garments: they shall clothe themselves with trembling; they shall sit upon the ground, and shall tremble every moment, and be astonished at thee.

units.leftText: They will take up a lamentation over you, and tell you,
units.rightText: And they shall take up a lamentation over thee, and say to thee, How art thou destroyed, that wast inhabited by seafaring men, the renowned city, that was strong in the sea, she and her inhabitants, that caused their terror to be on all that dwelt there!

units.leftText: Now the islands will tremble in the day of your fall.
units.rightText: Now shall the isles tremble in the day of thy fall; yea, the isles that are in the sea shall be dismayed at thy departure.

units.leftText: “For the Lord GOD says: ‘When I make you a desolate city, like the cities that are not inhabited, when I bring up the deep on you, and the great waters cover you,
units.rightText: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: When I shall make thee a desolate city, like the cities that are not inhabited; when I shall bring up the deep upon thee, and the great waters shall cover thee;

units.leftText: then I will bring you down with those who descend into the pit, to the people of old time, and will make you dwell in the lower parts of the earth, in the places that are desolate of old, with those who go down to the pit, that you be not inhabited; and I will set glory in the land of the living.
units.rightText: then will I bring thee down with them that descend into the pit, to the people of old time, and will make thee to dwell in the nether parts of the earth, in the places that are desolate of old, with them that go down to the pit, that thou be not inhabited; and I will set glory in the land of the living.

units.leftText: I will make you a terror, and you will no more have any being. Though you are sought for, yet you will never be found again,’ says the Lord GOD.”
units.rightText: I will make thee a terror, and thou shalt no more have any being; though thou be sought for, yet shalt thou never be found again, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: The LORD’s word came again to me, saying,
units.rightText: The word of Jehovah came again unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “You, son of man, take up a lamentation over Tyre;
units.rightText: And thou, son of man, take up a lamentation over Tyre;

units.leftText: and tell Tyre, ‘You who dwell at the entry of the sea, who are the merchant of the peoples to many islands, the Lord GOD says:
units.rightText: and say unto Tyre, O thou that dwellest at the entry of the sea, that art the merchant of the peoples unto many isles, thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Thou, O Tyre, hast said, I am perfect in beauty.

units.leftText: Your borders are in the heart of the seas.
units.rightText: Thy borders are in the heart of the seas; thy builders have perfected thy beauty.

units.leftText: They have made all your planks of cypress trees from Senir.
units.rightText: They have made all thy planks of fir-trees from Senir; they have taken a cedar from Lebanon to make a mast for thee.

units.leftText: They have made your oars of the oaks of Bashan.
units.rightText: Of the oaks of Bashan have they made thine oars; they have made thy benches of ivory inlaid in boxwood, from the isles of Kittim.

units.leftText: Your sail was of fine linen with embroidered work from Egypt,
units.rightText: Of fine linen with broidered work from Egypt was thy sail, that it might be to thee for an ensign; blue and purple from the isles of Elishah was thine awning.

units.leftText: The inhabitants of Sidon and Arvad were your rowers.
units.rightText: The inhabitants of Sidon and Arvad were thy rowers: thy wise men, O Tyre, were in thee, they were thy pilots.

units.leftText: The old men of Gebal
units.rightText: The old men of Gebal and the wise men thereof were in thee thy calkers: all the ships of the sea with their mariners were in thee to deal in thy merchandise.

units.leftText: “‘“Persia, Lud, and Put were in your army,
units.rightText: Persia and Lud and Put were in thine army, thy men of war: they hanged the shield and helmet in thee; they set forth thy comeliness.

units.leftText: The men of Arvad with your army were on your walls all around,
units.rightText: The men of Arvad with thine army were upon thy walls round about, and valorous men were in thy towers; they hanged their shields upon thy walls round about; they have perfected thy beauty.

units.leftText: “‘“Tarshish was your merchant by reason of the multitude of all kinds of riches. They traded for your wares with silver, iron, tin, and lead.
units.rightText: Tarshish was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of all kinds of riches; with silver, iron, tin, and lead, they traded for thy wares.

units.leftText: “‘“Javan, Tubal, and Meshech were your traders. They traded the persons of men and vessels of bronze for your merchandise.
units.rightText: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech, they were thy traffickers; they traded the persons of men and vessels of brass for thy merchandise.

units.leftText: “‘“They of the house of Togarmah traded for your wares with horses, war horses, and mules.
units.rightText: They of the house of Togarmah traded for thy wares with horses and war-horses and mules.

units.leftText: “‘“The men of Dedan traded with you. Many islands were the market of your hand. They brought you horns of ivory and ebony in exchange.
units.rightText: The men of Dedan were thy traffickers; many isles were the mart of thy hand: they brought thee in exchange horns of ivory and ebony.

units.leftText: “‘“Syria was your merchant by reason of the multitude of your handiworks. They traded for your wares with emeralds, purple, embroidered work, fine linen, coral, and rubies.
units.rightText: Syria was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of thy handiworks: they traded for thy wares with emeralds, purple, and broidered work, and fine linen, and coral, and rubies.

units.leftText: “‘“Judah and the land of Israel were your traders. They traded wheat of Minnith, confections, honey, oil, and balm for your merchandise.
units.rightText: Judah, and the land of Israel, they were thy traffickers: they traded for thy merchandise wheat of Minnith, and pannag, and honey, and oil, and balm.

units.leftText: “‘“Damascus was your merchant for the multitude of your handiworks by reason of the multitude of all kinds of riches, with the wine of Helbon, and white wool.
units.rightText: Damascus was thy merchant for the multitude of thy handiworks, by reason of the multitude of all kinds of riches, with the wine of Helbon, and white wool.

units.leftText: “‘“Vedan and Javan traded with yarn for your wares; wrought iron, cassia, and calamus were among your merchandise.
units.rightText: Vedan and Javan traded with yarn for thy wares: bright iron, cassia, and calamus, were among thy merchandise.

units.leftText: “‘“Dedan was your merchant in precious saddle blankets for riding.
units.rightText: Dedan was thy trafficker in precious cloths for riding.

units.leftText: “‘“Arabia and all the princes of Kedar were your favorite dealers in lambs, rams, and goats. In these, they were your merchants.
units.rightText: Arabia, and all the princes of Kedar, they were the merchants of thy hand; in lambs, and rams, and goats, in these were they thy merchants.

units.leftText: “‘“The traders of Sheba and Raamah were your traders. They traded for your wares with the best of all spices, all precious stones, and gold.
units.rightText: The traffickers of Sheba and Raamah, they were thy traffickers; they traded for thy wares with the chief of all spices, and with all precious stones, and gold.

units.leftText: “‘“Haran, Canneh, Eden, the traders of Sheba, Asshur and Chilmad, were your traders.
units.rightText: Haran and Canneh and Eden, the traffickers of Sheba, Asshur and Chilmad, were thy traffickers.

units.leftText: These were your traders in choice wares, in wrappings of blue and embroidered work, and in cedar chests of rich clothing bound with cords, among your merchandise.
units.rightText: These were thy traffickers in choice wares, in wrappings of blue and broidered work, and in chests of rich apparel, bound with cords and made of cedar, among thy merchandise.

units.leftText: “‘“The ships of Tarshish were your caravans for your merchandise.
units.rightText: The ships of Tarshish were thy caravans for thy merchandise: and thou wast replenished, and made very glorious in the heart of the seas.

units.leftText: Your rowers have brought you into great waters.
units.rightText: Thy rowers have brought thee into great waters: the east wind hath broken thee in the heart of the seas.

units.leftText: Your riches, your wares, your merchandise,
units.rightText: Thy riches, and thy wares, thy merchandise, thy mariners, and thy pilots, thy calkers, and the dealers in thy merchandise, and all thy men of war, that are in thee, with all thy company which is in the midst of thee, shall fall into the heart of the seas in the day of thy ruin.

units.leftText: At the sound of the cry of your pilots,
units.rightText: At the sound of the cry of thy pilots the suburbs shall shake.

units.leftText: All who handle the oars,
units.rightText: And all that handle the oar, the mariners, and all the pilots of the sea, shall come down from their ships; they shall stand upon the land,

units.leftText: and will cause their voice to be heard over you,
units.rightText: and shall cause their voice to be heard over thee, and shall cry bitterly, and shall cast up dust upon their heads; they shall wallow themselves in the ashes:

units.leftText: They will make themselves bald for you,
units.rightText: and they shall make themselves bald for thee, and gird them with sackcloth, and they shall weep for thee in bitterness of soul with bitter mourning.

units.leftText: In their wailing they will take up a lamentation for you,
units.rightText: And in their wailing they shall take up a lamentation for thee, and lament over thee, saying, Who is there like Tyre, like her that is brought to silence in the midst of the sea?

units.leftText: When your wares came from the seas,
units.rightText: When thy wares went forth out of the seas, thou filledst many peoples; thou didst enrich the kings of the earth with the multitude of thy riches and of thy merchandise.

units.leftText: In the time that you were broken by the seas,
units.rightText: In the time that thou wast broken by the seas in the depths of the waters, thy merchandise and all thy company did fall in the midst of thee.

units.leftText: All the inhabitants of the islands are astonished at you,
units.rightText: All the inhabitants of the isles are astonished at thee, and their kings are horribly afraid; they are troubled in their countenance.

units.leftText: The merchants among the peoples hiss at you.
units.rightText: The merchants among the peoples hiss at thee; thou art become a terror, and thou shalt nevermore have any being.

units.leftText: The LORD’s word came again to me, saying,
units.rightText: The word of Jehovah came again unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, tell the prince of Tyre, ‘The Lord GOD says:
units.rightText: Son of man, say unto the prince of Tyre, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because thy heart is lifted up, and thou hast said, I am a god, I sit in the seat of God, in the midst of the seas; yet thou art man, and not God, though thou didst set thy heart as the heart of God;—

units.leftText: behold, you are wiser than Daniel.
units.rightText: behold, thou art wiser than Daniel; there is no secret that is hidden from thee;

units.leftText: By your wisdom and by your understanding you have gotten yourself riches,
units.rightText: by thy wisdom and by thine understanding thou hast gotten thee riches, and hast gotten gold and silver into thy treasures;

units.leftText: By your great wisdom
units.rightText: by thy great wisdom and by thy traffic hast thou increased thy riches, and thy heart is lifted up because of thy riches;—

units.leftText: “‘therefore the Lord GOD says:
units.rightText: therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because thou hast set thy heart as the heart of God,

units.leftText: therefore, behold, I will bring strangers on you,
units.rightText: therefore, behold, I will bring strangers upon thee, the terrible of the nations; and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of thy wisdom, and they shall defile thy brightness.

units.leftText: They will bring you down to the pit.
units.rightText: They shall bring thee down to the pit; and thou shalt die the death of them that are slain, in the heart of the seas.

units.leftText: Will you yet say before him who kills you, ‘I am God’?
units.rightText: Wilt thou yet say before him that slayeth thee, I am God? but thou art man, and not God, in the hand of him that woundeth thee.

units.leftText: You will die the death of the uncircumcised
units.rightText: Thou shalt die the death of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: Moreover the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, take up a lamentation over the king of Tyre, and tell him, ‘The Lord GOD says:
units.rightText: Son of man, take up a lamentation over the king of Tyre, and say unto him, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Thou sealest up the sum, full of wisdom, and perfect in beauty.

units.leftText: You were in Eden,
units.rightText: Thou wast in Eden, the garden of God; every precious stone was thy covering, the sardius, the topaz, and the diamond, the beryl, the onyx, and the jasper, the sapphire, the emerald, and the carbuncle, and gold: the workmanship of thy tabrets and of thy pipes was in thee; in the day that thou wast created they were prepared.

units.leftText: You were the anointed cherub who covers.
units.rightText: Thou wast the anointed cherub that covereth: and I set thee, so that thou wast upon the holy mountain of God; thou hast walked up and down in the midst of the stones of fire.

units.leftText: You were perfect in your ways from the day that you were created,
units.rightText: Thou wast perfect in thy ways from the day that thou wast created, till unrighteousness was found in thee.

units.leftText: By the abundance of your commerce, your insides were filled with violence,
units.rightText: By the abundance of thy traffic they filled the midst of thee with violence, and thou hast sinned: therefore have I cast thee as profane out of the mountain of God; and I have destroyed thee, O covering cherub, from the midst of the stones of fire.

units.leftText: Your heart was lifted up because of your beauty.
units.rightText: Thy heart was lifted up because of thy beauty; thou hast corrupted thy wisdom by reason of thy brightness: I have cast thee to the ground; I have laid thee before kings, that they may behold thee.

units.leftText: By the multitude of your iniquities,
units.rightText: By the multitude of thine iniquities, in the unrighteousness of thy traffic, thou hast profaned thy sanctuaries; therefore have I brought forth a fire from the midst of thee; it hath devoured thee, and I have turned thee to ashes upon the earth in the sight of all them that behold thee.

units.leftText: All those who know you among the peoples will be astonished at you.
units.rightText: All they that know thee among the peoples shall be astonished at thee: thou art become a terror, and thou shalt nevermore have any being.

units.leftText: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, set your face toward Sidon, and prophesy against it,
units.rightText: Son of man, set thy face toward Sidon, and prophesy against it,

units.leftText: and say, ‘The Lord GOD says:
units.rightText: and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I am against thee, O Sidon; and I will be glorified in the midst of thee; and they shall know that I am Jehovah, when I shall have executed judgments in her, and shall be sanctified in her.

units.leftText: For I will send pestilence into her,
units.rightText: For I will send pestilence into her, and blood into her streets; and the wounded shall fall in the midst of her, with the sword upon her on every side; and they shall know that I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: “‘“There will no longer be a pricking brier to the house of Israel, nor a hurting thorn of any that are around them that scorned them. Then they will know that I am the Lord GOD.”
units.rightText: And there shall be no more a pricking brier unto the house of Israel, nor a hurting thorn of any that are round about them, that did despite unto them; and they shall know that I am the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: “‘The Lord GOD says: “When I have gathered the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they are scattered, and am shown as holy among them in the sight of the nations, then they will dwell in their own land which I gave to my servant Jacob.
units.rightText: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: When I shall have gathered the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they are scattered, and shall be sanctified in them in the sight of the nations, then shall they dwell in their own land which I gave to my servant Jacob.

units.leftText: They will dwell in it securely. Yes, they will build houses, plant vineyards, and will dwell securely when I have executed judgments on all those around them who have treated them with contempt. Then they will know that I am the LORD their God.”’”
units.rightText: And they shall dwell securely therein; yea, they shall build houses, and plant vineyards, and shall dwell securely, when I have executed judgments upon all those that do them despite round about them; and they shall know that I am Jehovah their God.

units.leftText: In the tenth year, in the tenth month, on the twelfth day of the month, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: In the tenth year, in the tenth month, in the twelfth day of the month, the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, set your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him and against all Egypt.
units.rightText: Son of man, set thy face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him, and against all Egypt;

units.leftText: Speak and say, ‘The Lord GOD says:
units.rightText: speak, and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I am against thee, Pharaoh king of Egypt, the great monster that lieth in the midst of his rivers, that hath said, My river is mine own, and I have made it for myself.

units.leftText: I will put hooks in your jaws,
units.rightText: And I will put hooks in thy jaws, and I will cause the fish of thy rivers to stick unto thy scales; and I will bring thee up out of the midst of thy rivers, with all the fish of thy rivers which stick unto thy scales.

units.leftText: I’ll cast you out into the wilderness,
units.rightText: And I will cast thee forth into the wilderness, thee and all the fish of thy rivers: thou shalt fall upon the open field; thou shalt not be brought together, nor gathered; I have given thee for food to the beasts of the earth and to the birds of the heavens.

units.leftText: “‘“All the inhabitants of Egypt will know that I am the LORD, because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel.
units.rightText: And all the inhabitants of Egypt shall know that I am Jehovah, because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel.

units.leftText: When they took hold of you by your hand, you broke and tore all their shoulders. When they leaned on you, you broke and paralyzed all of their thighs.”
units.rightText: When they took hold of thee by thy hand, thou didst break, and didst rend all their shoulders; and when they leaned upon thee, thou brakest, and madest all their loins to be at a stand.

units.leftText: “‘Therefore the Lord GOD says: “Behold, I will bring a sword on you, and will cut off man and animal from you.
units.rightText: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will bring a sword upon thee, and will cut off from thee man and beast.

units.leftText: The land of Egypt will be a desolation and a waste. Then they will know that I am the LORD.
units.rightText: And the land of Egypt shall be a desolation and a waste; and they shall know that I am Jehovah. Because he hath said, The river is mine, and I have made it;

units.leftText: therefore, behold, I am against you and against your rivers. I will make the land of Egypt an utter waste and desolation, from the tower of Seveneh even to the border of Ethiopia.
units.rightText: therefore, behold, I am against thee, and against thy rivers, and I will make the land of Egypt an utter waste and desolation, from the tower of Seveneh even unto the border of Ethiopia.

units.leftText: No foot of man will pass through it, nor will any animal foot pass through it. It won’t be inhabited for forty years.
units.rightText: No foot of man shall pass through it, nor foot of beast shall pass through it, neither shall it be inhabited forty years.

units.leftText: I will make the land of Egypt a desolation in the middle of the countries that are desolate. Her cities among the cities that are laid waste will be a desolation forty years. I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.”
units.rightText: And I will make the land of Egypt a desolation in the midst of the countries that are desolate; and her cities among the cities that are laid waste shall be a desolation forty years; and I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.

units.leftText: “‘For the Lord GOD says: “At the end of forty years I will gather the Egyptians from the peoples where they were scattered.
units.rightText: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: At the end of forty years will I gather the Egyptians from the peoples whither they were scattered;

units.leftText: I will reverse the captivity of Egypt, and will cause them to return into the land of Pathros, into the land of their birth. There they will be a lowly kingdom.
units.rightText: and I will bring back the captivity of Egypt, and will cause them to return into the land of Pathros, into the land of their birth; and they shall be there a base kingdom.

units.leftText: It will be the lowest of the kingdoms. It won’t lift itself up above the nations any more. I will diminish them so that they will no longer rule over the nations.
units.rightText: It shall be the basest of the kingdoms; neither shall it any more lift itself up above the nations: and I will diminish them, that they shall no more rule over the nations.

units.leftText: It will no longer be the confidence of the house of Israel, bringing iniquity to memory, when they turn to look after them. Then they will know that I am the Lord GOD.”’”
units.rightText: And it shall be no more the confidence of the house of Israel, bringing iniquity to remembrance, when they turn to look after them: and they shall know that I am the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: It came to pass in the twenty-seventh year, in the first month, in the first day of the month, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And it came to pass in the seven and twentieth year, in the first month, in the first day of the month, the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon caused his army to serve a great service against Tyre. Every head was made bald, and every shoulder was worn; yet he had no wages, nor did his army, from Tyre, for the service that he had served against it.
units.rightText: Son of man, Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon caused his army to serve a great service against Tyre: every head was made bald, and every shoulder was worn; yet had he no wages, nor his army, from Tyre, for the service that he had served against it.

units.leftText: Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I will give the land of Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon. He will carry off her multitude, take her plunder, and take her prey. That will be the wages for his army.
units.rightText: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will give the land of Egypt unto Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; and he shall carry off her multitude, and take her spoil, and take her prey; and it shall be the wages for his army.

units.leftText: I have given him the land of Egypt as his payment for which he served, because they worked for me,’ says the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: I have given him the land of Egypt as his recompense for which he served, because they wrought for me, saith the Lord Jehovah.
