units.leftText: “In that day I will cause a horn to sprout for the house of Israel, and I will open your mouth among them. Then they will know that I am the LORD.”
units.rightText: In that day will I cause a horn to bud forth unto the house of Israel, and I will give thee the opening of the mouth in the midst of them; and they shall know that I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: The LORD’s word came again to me, saying,
units.rightText: The word of Jehovah came again unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, prophesy, and say, ‘The Lord GOD says:
units.rightText: Son of man, prophesy, and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Wail ye, Alas for the day!

units.leftText: For the day is near,
units.rightText: For the day is near, even the day of Jehovah is near; it shall be a day of clouds, a time of the nations.

units.leftText: A sword will come on Egypt,
units.rightText: And a sword shall come upon Egypt, and anguish shall be in Ethiopia, when the slain shall fall in Egypt; and they shall take away her multitude, and her foundations shall be broken down.

units.leftText: “‘“Ethiopia, Put, Lud, all the mixed people, Cub, and the children of the land that is allied with them, will fall with them by the sword.”
units.rightText: Ethiopia, and Put, and Lud, and all the mingled people, and Cub, and the children of the land that is in league, shall fall with them by the sword.

units.leftText: “‘The LORD says:
units.rightText: Thus saith Jehovah: They also that uphold Egypt shall fall; and the pride of her power shall come down: from the tower of Seveneh shall they fall in it by the sword, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: “They will be desolate in the middle of the countries that are desolate.
units.rightText: And they shall be desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate; and her cities shall be in the midst of the cities that are wasted.

units.leftText: They will know that I am the LORD
units.rightText: And they shall know that I am Jehovah, when I have set a fire in Egypt, and all her helpers are destroyed.

units.leftText: “‘“In that day messengers will go out from before me in ships to make the careless Ethiopians afraid. There will be anguish on them, as in the day of Egypt; for, behold, it comes.”
units.rightText: In that day shall messengers go forth from before me in ships to make the careless Ethiopians afraid; and there shall be anguish upon them, as in the day of Egypt; for, lo, it cometh.

units.leftText: “‘The Lord GOD says:
units.rightText: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will also make the multitude of Egypt to cease, by the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon.

units.leftText: He and his people with him,
units.rightText: He and his people with him, the terrible of the nations, shall be brought in to destroy the land; and they shall draw their swords against Egypt, and fill the land with the slain.

units.leftText: I will make the rivers dry,
units.rightText: And I will make the rivers dry, and will sell the land into the hand of evil men; and I will make the land desolate, and all that is therein, by the hand of strangers: I, Jehovah, have spoken it.

units.leftText: “‘The Lord GOD says:
units.rightText: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will also destroy the idols, and I will cause the images to cease from Memphis; and there shall be no more a prince from the land of Egypt: and I will put a fear in the land of Egypt.

units.leftText: I will make Pathros desolate,
units.rightText: And I will make Pathros desolate, and will set a fire in Zoan, and will execute judgments upon No.

units.leftText: I will pour my wrath on Sin,
units.rightText: And I will pour my wrath upon Sin, the stronghold of Egypt; and I will cut off the multitude of No.

units.leftText: I will set a fire in Egypt
units.rightText: And I will set a fire in Egypt: Sin shall be in great anguish, and No shall be broken up; and Memphis shall have adversaries in the day-time.

units.leftText: The young men of Aven and of Pibeseth will fall by the sword.
units.rightText: The young men of Aven and of Pi-beseth shall fall by the sword; and these cities shall go into captivity.

units.leftText: At Tehaphnehes also the day will withdraw itself,
units.rightText: At Tehaphnehes also the day shall withdraw itself, when I shall break there the yokes of Egypt, and the pride of her power shall cease in her: as for her, a cloud shall cover her, and her daughters shall go into captivity.

units.leftText: Thus I will execute judgments on Egypt.
units.rightText: Thus will I execute judgments upon Egypt; and they shall know that I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: In the eleventh year, in the first month, in the seventh day of the month, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first month, in the seventh day of the month, that the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt. Behold, it has not been bound up, to apply medicines, to put a bandage to bind it, that it may become strong to hold the sword.
units.rightText: Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and, lo, it hath not been bound up, to apply healing medicines, to put a bandage to bind it, that it be strong to hold the sword.

units.leftText: Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and will break his arms, the strong arm, and that which was broken. I will cause the sword to fall out of his hand.
units.rightText: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and will break his arms, the strong arm, and that which was broken; and I will cause the sword to fall out of his hand.

units.leftText: I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.
units.rightText: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.

units.leftText: I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and put my sword in his hand; but I will break the arms of Pharaoh, and he will groan before the king of Babylon with the groaning of a mortally wounded man.
units.rightText: And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and put my sword in his hand: but I will break the arms of Pharaoh, and he shall groan before him with the groanings of a deadly wounded man.

units.leftText: I will hold up the arms of the king of Babylon, but the arms of Pharaoh will fall down. Then they will know that I am the LORD when I put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he stretches it out on the land of Egypt.
units.rightText: And I will hold up the arms of the king of Babylon; and the arms of Pharaoh shall fall down; and they shall know that I am Jehovah, when I shall put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall stretch it out upon the land of Egypt.

units.leftText: I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and disperse them through the countries. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’”
units.rightText: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and disperse them through the countries; and they shall know that I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: In the eleventh year, in the third month, in the first day of the month, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the third month, in the first day of the month, that the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, tell Pharaoh king of Egypt and his multitude:
units.rightText: Son of man, say unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, and to his multitude: Whom art thou like in thy greatness?

units.leftText: Behold, the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon
units.rightText: Behold, the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon with fair branches, and with a forest-like shade, and of high stature; and its top was among the thick boughs.

units.leftText: The waters nourished it.
units.rightText: The waters nourished it, the deep made it to grow: the rivers thereof ran round about its plantation; and it sent out its channels unto all the trees of the field.

units.leftText: Therefore its stature was exalted above all the trees of the field;
units.rightText: Therefore its stature was exalted above all the trees of the field; and its boughs were multiplied, and its branches became long by reason of many waters, when it shot them forth.

units.leftText: All the birds of the sky made their nests in its boughs.
units.rightText: All the birds of the heavens made their nests in its boughs; and under its branches did all the beasts of the field bring forth their young; and under its shadow dwelt all great nations.

units.leftText: Thus it was beautiful in its greatness,
units.rightText: Thus was it fair in its greatness, in the length of its branches; for its root was by many waters.

units.leftText: The cedars in the garden of God could not hide it.
units.rightText: The cedars in the garden of God could not hide it; the fir-trees were not like its boughs, and the plane-trees were not as its branches; nor was any tree in the garden of God like unto it in its beauty.

units.leftText: I made it beautiful by the multitude of its branches,
units.rightText: I made it fair by the multitude of its branches, so that all the trees of Eden, that were in the garden of God, envied it.

units.leftText: “Therefore thus said the Lord GOD: ‘Because he is exalted in stature, and he has set his top among the thick branches, and his heart is lifted up in his height,
units.rightText: Therefore thus said the Lord Jehovah: Because thou art exalted in stature, and he hath set his top among the thick boughs, and his heart is lifted up in his height;

units.leftText: I will deliver him into the hand of the mighty one of the nations. He will surely deal with him. I have driven him out for his wickedness.
units.rightText: I will even deliver him into the hand of the mighty one of the nations; he shall surely deal with him; I have driven him out for his wickedness.

units.leftText: Foreigners, the tyrants of the nations, have cut him off and have left him. His branches have fallen on the mountains and in all the valleys, and his boughs are broken by all the watercourses of the land. All the peoples of the earth have gone down from his shadow and have left him.
units.rightText: And strangers, the terrible of the nations, have cut him off, and have left him: upon the mountains and in all the valleys his branches are fallen, and his boughs are broken by all the watercourses of the land; and all the peoples of the earth are gone down from his shadow, and have left him.

units.leftText: All the birds of the sky will dwell on his ruin, and all the animals of the field will be on his branches,
units.rightText: Upon his ruin all the birds of the heavens shall dwell, and all the beasts of the field shall be upon his branches;

units.leftText: to the end that none of all the trees by the waters exalt themselves in their stature, and don’t set their top among the thick boughs. Their mighty ones don’t stand up on their height, even all who drink water; for they are all delivered to death, to the lower parts of the earth, among the children of men, with those who go down to the pit.’
units.rightText: to the end that none of all the trees by the waters exalt themselves in their stature, neither set their top among the thick boughs, nor that their mighty ones stand up in their height, even all that drink water: for they are all delivered unto death, to the nether parts of the earth, in the midst of the children of men, with them that go down to the pit.

units.leftText: “The Lord GOD says: ‘In the day when he went down to Sheol, I caused a mourning. I covered the deep for him, and I restrained its rivers. The great waters were stopped. I caused Lebanon to mourn for him, and all the trees of the field fainted for him.
units.rightText: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: In the day when he went down to Sheol I caused a mourning: I covered the deep for him, and I restrained the rivers thereof; and the great waters were stayed; and I caused Lebanon to mourn for him, and all the trees of the field fainted for him.
leftNotes: 31:15 Sheol is the place of the dead.

units.leftText: I made the nations to shake at the sound of his fall, when I cast him down to Sheol with those who descend into the pit. All the trees of Eden, the choice and best of Lebanon, all that drink water, were comforted in the lower parts of the earth.
units.rightText: I made the nations to shake at the sound of his fall, when I cast him down to Sheol with them that descend into the pit; and all the trees of Eden, the choice and best of Lebanon, all that drink water, were comforted in the nether parts of the earth.
leftNotes: 31:16 Sheol is the place of the dead.

units.leftText: They also went down into Sheol with him to those who are slain by the sword; yes, those who were his arm, who lived under his shadow in the middle of the nations.
units.rightText: They also went down into Sheol with him unto them that are slain by the sword; yea, they that were his arm, that dwelt under his shadow in the midst of the nations.

units.leftText: “‘To whom are you thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden? Yet you will be brought down with the trees of Eden to the lower parts of the earth. You will lie in the middle of the uncircumcised, with those who are slain by the sword.
units.rightText: To whom art thou thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden? yet shalt thou be brought down with the trees of Eden unto the nether parts of the earth: thou shalt lie in the midst of the uncircumcised, with them that are slain by the sword. This is Pharaoh and all his multitude, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: In the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, in the first day of the month, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And it came to pass in the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, in the first day of the month, that the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, take up a lamentation over Pharaoh king of Egypt, and tell him,
units.rightText: Son of man, take up a lamentation over Pharaoh king of Egypt, and say unto him, Thou wast likened unto a young lion of the nations: yet art thou as a monster in the seas; and thou didst break forth with thy rivers, and troubledst the waters with thy feet, and fouledst their rivers.

units.leftText: The Lord GOD says:
units.rightText: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will spread out my net upon thee with a company of many peoples; and they shall bring thee up in my net.

units.leftText: I will leave you on the land.
units.rightText: And I will leave thee upon the land, I will cast thee forth upon the open field, and will cause all the birds of the heavens to settle upon thee, and I will satisfy the beasts of the whole earth with thee.

units.leftText: I will lay your flesh on the mountains,
units.rightText: And I will lay thy flesh upon the mountains, and fill the valleys with thy height.

units.leftText: I will also water the land in which you swim with your blood,
units.rightText: I will also water with thy blood the land wherein thou swimmest, even to the mountains; and the watercourses shall be full of thee.

units.leftText: When I extinguish you, I will cover the heavens
units.rightText: And when I shall extinguish thee, I will cover the heavens, and make the stars thereof dark; I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon shall not give its light.

units.leftText: I will make all the bright lights of the sky dark over you,
units.rightText: All the bright lights of heaven will I make dark over thee, and set darkness upon thy land, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: “I will also trouble the hearts of many peoples,
units.rightText: I will also vex the hearts of many peoples, when I shall bring thy destruction among the nations, into the countries which thou hast not known.

units.leftText: Yes, I will make many peoples amazed at you,
units.rightText: Yea, I will make many peoples amazed at thee, and their kings shall be horribly afraid for thee, when I shall brandish my sword before them; and they shall tremble at every moment, every man for his own life, in the day of thy fall.

units.leftText: For the Lord GOD says:
units.rightText: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: The sword of the king of Babylon shall come upon thee.

units.leftText: I will cause your multitude to fall by the swords of the mighty.
units.rightText: By the swords of the mighty will I cause thy multitude to fall; the terrible of the nations are they all: and they shall bring to nought the pride of Egypt, and all the multitude thereof shall be destroyed.

units.leftText: I will destroy also all its animals from beside many waters.
units.rightText: I will destroy also all the beasts thereof from beside many waters; neither shall the foot of man trouble them any more, nor the hoofs of beasts trouble them.

units.leftText: Then I will make their waters clear,
units.rightText: Then will I make their waters clear, and cause their rivers to run like oil, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: “When I make the land of Egypt desolate and waste,
units.rightText: When I shall make the land of Egypt desolate and waste, a land destitute of that whereof it was full, when I shall smite all them that dwell therein, then shall they know that I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: “‘“This is the lamentation with which they will lament. The daughters of the nations will lament with this. They will lament with it over Egypt, and over all her multitude,” says the Lord GOD.’”
units.rightText: This is the lamentation wherewith they shall lament; the daughters of the nations shall lament therewith; over Egypt, and over all her multitude, shall they lament therewith, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: Also in the twelfth year, in the fifteenth day of the month, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: It came to pass also in the twelfth year, in the fifteenth day of the month, that the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, wail for the multitude of Egypt, and cast them down, even her and the daughters of the famous nations, to the lower parts of the earth, with those who go down into the pit.
units.rightText: Son of man, wail for the multitude of Egypt, and cast them down, even her, and the daughters of the famous nations, unto the nether parts of the earth, with them that go down into the pit.

units.leftText: Whom do you pass in beauty? Go down, and be laid with the uncircumcised.
units.rightText: Whom dost thou pass in beauty? go down, and be thou laid with the uncircumcised.

units.leftText: They will fall among those who are slain by the sword. She is delivered to the sword. Draw her away with all her multitudes.
units.rightText: They shall fall in the midst of them that are slain by the sword: she is delivered to the sword; draw her away and all her multitudes.

units.leftText: The strong among the mighty will speak to him out of the middle of Sheol with those who help him. They have gone down. The uncircumcised lie still, slain by the sword.
units.rightText: The strong among the mighty shall speak to him out of the midst of Sheol with them that help him: they are gone down, they lie still, even the uncircumcised, slain by the sword.
leftNotes: 32:21 Sheol is the place of the dead.

units.leftText: “Asshur is there with all her company. Her graves are all around her. All of them are slain, fallen by the sword,
units.rightText: Asshur is there and all her company; her graves are round about her; all of them slain, fallen by the sword;

units.leftText: whose graves are set in the uttermost parts of the pit, and her company is around her grave, all of them slain, fallen by the sword, who caused terror in the land of the living.
units.rightText: whose graves are set in the uttermost parts of the pit, and her company is round about her grave; all of them slain, fallen by the sword, who caused terror in the land of the living.

units.leftText: “There is Elam and all her multitude around her grave; all of them slain, fallen by the sword, who have gone down uncircumcised into the lower parts of the earth, who caused their terror in the land of the living, and have borne their shame with those who go down to the pit.
units.rightText: There is Elam and all her multitude round about her grave; all of them slain, fallen by the sword, who are gone down uncircumcised into the nether parts of the earth, who caused their terror in the land of the living, and have borne their shame with them that go down to the pit.

units.leftText: They have made Elam a bed among the slain with all her multitude. Her graves are around her, all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword; for their terror was caused in the land of the living, and they have borne their shame with those who go down to the pit. He is put among those who are slain.
units.rightText: They have set her a bed in the midst of the slain with all her multitude; her graves are round about her; all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword; for their terror was caused in the land of the living, and they have borne their shame with them that go down to the pit: he is put in the midst of them that are slain.

units.leftText: “There is Meshech, Tubal, and all their multitude. Their graves are around them, all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword; for they caused their terror in the land of the living.
units.rightText: There is Meshech, Tubal, and all their multitude; their graves are round about them; all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword; for they caused their terror in the land of the living.

units.leftText: They will not lie with the mighty who are fallen of the uncircumcised, who have gone down to Sheol with their weapons of war and have laid their swords under their heads. Their iniquities are on their bones; for they were the terror of the mighty in the land of the living.
units.rightText: And they shall not lie with the mighty that are fallen of the uncircumcised, that are gone down to Sheol with their weapons of war, and have laid their swords under their heads, and their iniquities are upon their bones; for they were the terror of the mighty in the land of the living.

units.leftText: “But you will be broken among the uncircumcised, and will lie with those who are slain by the sword.
units.rightText: But thou shalt be broken in the midst of the uncircumcised, and shalt lie with them that are slain by the sword.

units.leftText: “There is Edom, her kings, and all her princes, who in their might are laid with those who are slain by the sword. They will lie with the uncircumcised, and with those who go down to the pit.
units.rightText: There is Edom, her kings and all her princes, who in their might are laid with them that are slain by the sword: they shall lie with the uncircumcised, and with them that go down to the pit.

units.leftText: “There are the princes of the north, all of them, and all the Sidonians, who have gone down with the slain. They are put to shame in the terror which they caused by their might. They lie uncircumcised with those who are slain by the sword, and bear their shame with those who go down to the pit.
units.rightText: There are the princes of the north, all of them, and all the Sidonians, who are gone down with the slain; in the terror which they caused by their might they are put to shame; and they lie uncircumcised with them that are slain by the sword, and bear their shame with them that go down to the pit.

units.leftText: “Pharaoh will see them and will be comforted over all his multitude, even Pharaoh and all his army, slain by the sword,” says the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: Pharaoh shall see them, and shall be comforted over all his multitude, even Pharaoh and all his army, slain by the sword, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: “For I have put his terror in the land of the living. He will be laid among the uncircumcised, with those who are slain by the sword, even Pharaoh and all his multitude,” says the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: For I have put his terror in the land of the living; and he shall be laid in the midst of the uncircumcised, with them that are slain by the sword, even Pharaoh and all his multitude, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, speak to the children of your people, and tell them, ‘When I bring the sword on a land, and the people of the land take a man from among them, and set him for their watchman,
units.rightText: Son of man, speak to the children of thy people, and say unto them, When I bring the sword upon a land, and the people of the land take a man from among them, and set him for their watchman;

units.leftText: if, when he sees the sword come on the land, he blows the trumpet and warns the people,
units.rightText: if, when he seeth the sword come upon the land, he blow the trumpet, and warn the people;

units.leftText: then whoever hears the sound of the trumpet and doesn’t heed the warning, if the sword comes and takes him away, his blood will be on his own head.
units.rightText: then whosoever heareth the sound of the trumpet, and taketh not warning, if the sword come, and take him away, his blood shall be upon his own head.

units.leftText: He heard the sound of the trumpet and didn’t take warning. His blood will be on him; whereas if he had heeded the warning, he would have delivered his soul.
units.rightText: He heard the sound of the trumpet, and took not warning; his blood shall be upon him; whereas if he had taken warning, he would have delivered his soul.

units.leftText: But if the watchman sees the sword come and doesn’t blow the trumpet, and the people aren’t warned, and the sword comes and takes any person from among them, he is taken away in his iniquity, but his blood I will require at the watchman’s hand.’
units.rightText: But if the watchman see the sword come, and blow not the trumpet, and the people be not warned, and the sword come, and take any person from among them; he is taken away in his iniquity, but his blood will I require at the watchman’s hand.

units.leftText: “So you, son of man, I have set you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore hear the word from my mouth, and give them warnings from me.
units.rightText: So thou, son of man, I have set thee a watchman unto the house of Israel; therefore hear the word at my mouth, and give them warning from me.

units.leftText: When I tell the wicked, ‘O wicked man, you will surely die,’ and you don’t speak to warn the wicked from his way, that wicked man will die in his iniquity, but I will require his blood at your hand.
units.rightText: When I say unto the wicked, O wicked man, thou shalt surely die, and thou dost not speak to warn the wicked from his way; that wicked man shall die in his iniquity, but his blood will I require at thy hand.

units.leftText: Nevertheless, if you warn the wicked of his way to turn from it, and he doesn’t turn from his way; he will die in his iniquity, but you have delivered your soul.
units.rightText: Nevertheless, if thou warn the wicked of his way to turn from it, and he turn not from his way; he shall die in his iniquity, but thou hast delivered thy soul.

units.leftText: “You, son of man, tell the house of Israel: ‘You say this, “Our transgressions and our sins are on us, and we pine away in them. How then can we live?”’
units.rightText: And thou, son of man, say unto the house of Israel: Thus ye speak, saying, Our transgressions and our sins are upon us, and we pine away in them; how then can we live?

units.leftText: Tell them, ‘“As I live,” says the Lord GOD, “I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but that the wicked turn from his way and live. Turn, turn from your evil ways! For why will you die, house of Israel?”’
units.rightText: Say unto them, As I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked; but that the wicked turn from his way and live: turn ye, turn ye from your evil ways; for why will ye die, O house of Israel?

units.leftText: “You, son of man, tell the children of your people, ‘The righteousness of the righteous will not deliver him in the day of his disobedience. And as for the wickedness of the wicked, he will not fall by it in the day that he turns from his wickedness; neither will he who is righteous be able to live by it in the day that he sins.
units.rightText: And thou, son of man, say unto the children of thy people, The righteousness of the righteous shall not deliver him in the day of his transgression; and as for the wickedness of the wicked, he shall not fall thereby in the day that he turneth from his wickedness; neither shall he that is righteous be able to live thereby in the day that he sinneth.

units.leftText: When I tell the righteous that he will surely live, if he trusts in his righteousness and commits iniquity, none of his righteous deeds will be remembered; but he will die in his iniquity that he has committed.
units.rightText: When I say to the righteous, that he shall surely live; if he trust to his righteousness, and commit iniquity, none of his righteous deeds shall be remembered; but in his iniquity that he hath committed, therein shall he die.

units.leftText: Again, when I say to the wicked, “You will surely die,” if he turns from his sin and does that which is lawful and right,
units.rightText: Again, when I say unto the wicked, Thou shalt surely die; if he turn from his sin, and do that which is lawful and right;

units.leftText: if the wicked restore the pledge, give again that which he had taken by robbery, walk in the statutes of life, committing no iniquity, he will surely live. He will not die.
units.rightText: if the wicked restore the pledge, give again that which he had taken by robbery, walk in the statutes of life, committing no iniquity; he shall surely live, he shall not die.

units.leftText: None of his sins that he has committed will be remembered against him. He has done that which is lawful and right. He will surely live.
units.rightText: None of his sins that he hath committed shall be remembered against him: he hath done that which is lawful and right; he shall surely live.

units.leftText: “‘Yet the children of your people say, “The way of the Lord is not fair;” but as for them, their way is not fair.
units.rightText: Yet the children of thy people say, The way of the Lord is not equal: but as for them, their way is not equal.

units.leftText: When the righteous turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, he will even die therein.
units.rightText: When the righteous turneth from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, he shall even die therein.

units.leftText: When the wicked turns from his wickedness and does that which is lawful and right, he will live by it.
units.rightText: And when the wicked turneth from his wickedness, and doeth that which is lawful and right, he shall live thereby.

units.leftText: Yet you say, “The way of the Lord is not fair.” House of Israel, I will judge every one of you after his ways.’”
units.rightText: Yet ye say, The way of the Lord is not equal. O house of Israel, I will judge you every one after his ways.

units.leftText: In the twelfth year of our captivity, in the tenth month, in the fifth day of the month, one who had escaped out of Jerusalem came to me, saying, “The city has been defeated!”
units.rightText: And it came to pass in the twelfth year of our captivity, in the tenth month, in the fifth day of the month, that one that had escaped out of Jerusalem came unto me, saying, The city is smitten.

units.leftText: Now the LORD’s hand had been on me in the evening, before he who had escaped came; and he had opened my mouth until he came to me in the morning; and my mouth was opened, and I was no longer mute.
units.rightText: Now the hand of Jehovah had been upon me in the evening, before he that was escaped came; and he had opened my mouth, until he came to me in the morning; and my mouth was opened, and I was no more dumb.

units.leftText: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, those who inhabit the waste places in the land of Israel speak, saying, ‘Abraham was one, and he inherited the land; but we are many. The land is given us for inheritance.’
units.rightText: Son of man, they that inhabit those waste places in the land of Israel speak, saying, Abraham was one, and he inherited the land: but we are many; the land is given us for inheritance.

units.leftText: Therefore tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “You eat with the blood, and lift up your eyes to your idols, and shed blood. So should you possess the land?
units.rightText: Wherefore say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Ye eat with the blood, and lift up your eyes unto your idols, and shed blood: and shall ye possess the land?

units.leftText: You stand on your sword, you work abomination, and every one of you defiles his neighbor’s wife. So should you possess the land?”’
units.rightText: Ye stand upon your sword, ye work abomination, and ye defile every one his neighbor’s wife: and shall ye possess the land?

units.leftText: “You shall tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “As I live, surely those who are in the waste places will fall by the sword. I will give whoever is in the open field to the animals to be devoured, and those who are in the strongholds and in the caves will die of the pestilence.
units.rightText: Thus shalt thou say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: As I live, surely they that are in the waste places shall fall by the sword; and him that is in the open field will I give to the beasts to be devoured; and they that are in the strongholds and in the caves shall die of the pestilence.

units.leftText: I will make the land a desolation and an astonishment. The pride of her power will cease. The mountains of Israel will be desolate, so that no one will pass through.
units.rightText: And I will make the land a desolation and an astonishment; and the pride of her power shall cease; and the mountains of Israel shall be desolate, so that none shall pass through.

units.leftText: Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I have made the land a desolation and an astonishment because of all their abominations which they have committed.”’
units.rightText: Then shall they know that I am Jehovah, when I have made the land a desolation and an astonishment, because of all their abominations which they have committed.

units.leftText: “As for you, son of man, the children of your people talk about you by the walls and in the doors of the houses, and speak to one another, everyone to his brother, saying, ‘Please come and hear what the word is that comes out from the LORD.’
units.rightText: And as for thee, son of man, the children of thy people talk of thee by the walls and in the doors of the houses, and speak one to another, every one to his brother, saying, Come, I pray you, and hear what is the word that cometh forth from Jehovah.

units.leftText: They come to you as the people come, and they sit before you as my people, and they hear your words, but don’t do them; for with their mouth they show much love, but their heart goes after their gain.
units.rightText: And they come unto thee as the people cometh, and they sit before thee as my people, and they hear thy words, but do them not; for with their mouth they show much love, but their heart goeth after their gain.

units.leftText: Behold, you are to them as a very lovely song of one who has a pleasant voice, and can play well on an instrument; for they hear your words, but they don’t do them.
units.rightText: And, lo, thou art unto them as a very lovely song of one that hath a pleasant voice, and can play well on an instrument; for they hear thy words, but they do them not.

units.leftText: “When this comes to pass—behold, it comes—then they will know that a prophet has been among them.”
units.rightText: And when this cometh to pass (behold, it cometh), then shall they know that a prophet hath been among them.

units.leftText: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel. Prophesy, and tell them, even the shepherds, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Woe to the shepherds of Israel who feed themselves! Shouldn’t the shepherds feed the sheep?
units.rightText: Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel, prophesy, and say unto them, even to the shepherds, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Woe unto the shepherds of Israel that do feed themselves! should not the shepherds feed the sheep?

units.leftText: You eat the fat. You clothe yourself with the wool. You kill the fatlings, but you don’t feed the sheep.
units.rightText: Ye eat the fat, and ye clothe you with the wool, ye kill the fatlings; but ye feed not the sheep.

units.leftText: You haven’t strengthened the diseased. You haven’t healed that which was sick. You haven’t bound up that which was broken. You haven’t brought back that which was driven away. You haven’t sought that which was lost, but you have ruled over them with force and with rigor.
units.rightText: The diseased have ye not strengthened, neither have ye healed that which was sick, neither have ye bound up that which was broken, neither have ye brought back that which was driven away, neither have ye sought that which was lost; but with force and with rigor have ye ruled over them.

units.leftText: They were scattered, because there was no shepherd. They became food to all the animals of the field, and were scattered.
units.rightText: And they were scattered, because there was no shepherd; and they became food to all the beasts of the field, and were scattered.

units.leftText: My sheep wandered through all the mountains and on every high hill. Yes, my sheep were scattered on all the surface of the earth. There was no one who searched or sought.”
units.rightText: My sheep wandered through all the mountains, and upon every high hill: yea, my sheep were scattered upon all the face of the earth; and there was none that did search or seek after them.

units.leftText: “‘Therefore, you shepherds, hear the LORD’s word:
units.rightText: Therefore, ye shepherds, hear the word of Jehovah:

units.leftText: “As I live,” says the Lord GOD, “surely because my sheep became a prey, and my sheep became food to all the animals of the field, because there was no shepherd, and my shepherds didn’t search for my sheep, but the shepherds fed themselves, and didn’t feed my sheep,
units.rightText: As I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, surely forasmuch as my sheep became a prey, and my sheep became food to all the beasts of the field, because there was no shepherd, neither did my shepherds search for my sheep, but the shepherds fed themselves, and fed not my sheep;

units.leftText: therefore, you shepherds, hear the LORD’s word!”
units.rightText: therefore, ye shepherds, hear the word of Jehovah:

units.leftText: The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I am against the shepherds. I will require my sheep at their hand, and cause them to cease from feeding the sheep. The shepherds won’t feed themselves any more. I will deliver my sheep from their mouth, that they may not be food for them.”
units.rightText: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Behold, I am against the shepherds; and I will require my sheep at their hand, and cause them to cease from feeding the sheep; neither shall the shepherds feed themselves any more; and I will deliver my sheep from their mouth, that they may not be food for them.

units.leftText: “‘For the Lord GOD says: “Behold, I myself, even I, will search for my sheep, and will seek them out.
units.rightText: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I myself, even I, will search for my sheep, and will seek them out.

units.leftText: As a shepherd seeks out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered abroad, so I will seek out my sheep. I will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.
units.rightText: As a shepherd seeketh out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered abroad, so will I seek out my sheep; and I will deliver them out of all places whither they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.

units.leftText: I will bring them out from the peoples, and gather them from the countries, and will bring them into their own land. I will feed them on the mountains of Israel, by the watercourses, and in all the inhabited places of the country.
units.rightText: And I will bring them out from the peoples, and gather them from the countries, and will bring them into their own land; and I will feed them upon the mountains of Israel, by the watercourses, and in all the inhabited places of the country.

units.leftText: I will feed them with good pasture, and their fold will be on the mountains of the height of Israel. There they will lie down in a good fold. They will feed on rich pasture on the mountains of Israel.
units.rightText: I will feed them with good pasture; and upon the mountains of the height of Israel shall their fold be: there shall they lie down in a good fold; and on fat pasture shall they feed upon the mountains of Israel.

units.leftText: I myself will be the shepherd of my sheep, and I will cause them to lie down,” says the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: I myself will be the shepherd of my sheep, and I will cause them to lie down, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: “I will seek that which was lost, and will bring back that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick; but I will destroy the fat and the strong. I will feed them in justice.”’
units.rightText: I will seek that which was lost, and will bring back that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick: but the fat and the strong I will destroy; I will feed them in justice.

units.leftText: “As for you, O my flock, the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I judge between sheep and sheep, the rams and the male goats.
units.rightText: And as for you, O my flock, thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I judge between sheep and sheep, the rams and the he-goats.

units.leftText: Does it seem a small thing to you to have fed on the good pasture, but you must tread down with your feet the residue of your pasture? And to have drunk of the clear waters, but must you foul the residue with your feet?
units.rightText: Seemeth it a small thing unto you to have fed upon the good pasture, but ye must tread down with your feet the residue of your pasture? and to have drunk of the clear waters, but ye must foul the residue with your feet?

units.leftText: As for my sheep, they eat that which you have trodden with your feet, and they drink that which you have fouled with your feet.’
units.rightText: And as for my sheep, they eat that which ye have trodden with your feet, and they drink that which ye have fouled with your feet.

units.leftText: “Therefore the Lord GOD says to them: ‘Behold, I, even I, will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.
units.rightText: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah unto them: Behold, I, even I, will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.

units.leftText: Because you thrust with side and with shoulder, and push all the diseased with your horns, until you have scattered them abroad,
units.rightText: Because ye thrust with side and with shoulder, and push all the diseased with your horns, till ye have scattered them abroad;

units.leftText: therefore I will save my flock, and they will no more be a prey. I will judge between sheep and sheep.
units.rightText: therefore will I save my flock, and they shall no more be a prey; and I will judge between sheep and sheep.

units.leftText: I will set up one shepherd over them, and he will feed them, even my servant David. He will feed them, and he will be their shepherd.
units.rightText: And I will set up one shepherd over them, and he shall feed them, even my servant David; he shall feed them, and he shall be their shepherd.

units.leftText: I, the LORD, will be their God, and my servant David prince among them. I, the LORD, have spoken it.
units.rightText: And I, Jehovah, will be their God, and my servant David prince among them; I, Jehovah, have spoken it.

units.leftText: “‘I will make with them a covenant of peace, and will cause evil animals to cease out of the land. They will dwell securely in the wilderness and sleep in the woods.
units.rightText: And I will make with them a covenant of peace, and will cause evil beasts to cease out of the land; and they shall dwell securely in the wilderness, and sleep in the woods.

units.leftText: I will make them and the places around my hill a blessing. I will cause the shower to come down in its season. There will be showers of blessing.
units.rightText: And I will make them and the places round about my hill a blessing; and I will cause the shower to come down in its season; there shall be showers of blessing.

units.leftText: The tree of the field will yield its fruit, and the earth will yield its increase, and they will be secure in their land. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I have broken the bars of their yoke, and have delivered them out of the hand of those who made slaves of them.
units.rightText: And the tree of the field shall yield its fruit, and the earth shall yield its increase, and they shall be secure in their land; and they shall know that I am Jehovah, when I have broken the bars of their yoke, and have delivered them out of the hand of those that made bondmen of them.

units.leftText: They will no more be a prey to the nations, neither will the animals of the earth devour them; but they will dwell securely, and no one will make them afraid.
units.rightText: And they shall no more be a prey to the nations, neither shall the beasts of the earth devour them; but they shall dwell securely, and none shall make them afraid.

units.leftText: I will raise up to them a plantation for renown, and they will no more be consumed with famine in the land, and not bear the shame of the nations any more.
units.rightText: And I will raise up unto them a plantation for renown, and they shall be no more consumed with famine in the land, neither bear the shame of the nations any more.

units.leftText: They will know that I, the LORD, their God am with them, and that they, the house of Israel, are my people, says the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: And they shall know that I, Jehovah, their God am with them, and that they, the house of Israel, are my people, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: You my sheep, the sheep of my pasture, are men, and I am your God,’ says the Lord GOD.”
units.rightText: And ye my sheep, the sheep of my pasture, are men, and I am your God, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: Moreover the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, set your face against Mount Seir, and prophesy against it,
units.rightText: Son of man, set thy face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it,

units.leftText: and tell it, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I am against you, Mount Seir, and I will stretch out my hand against you. I will make you a desolation and an astonishment.
units.rightText: and say unto it, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I am against thee, O mount Seir, and I will stretch out my hand against thee, and I will make thee a desolation and an astonishment.

units.leftText: I will lay your cities waste, and you will be desolate. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
units.rightText: I will lay thy cities waste, and thou shalt be desolate; and thou shalt know that I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: “‘“Because you have had a perpetual hostility, and have given over the children of Israel to the power of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time of the iniquity of the end,
units.rightText: Because thou hast had a perpetual enmity, and hast given over the children of Israel to the power of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time of the iniquity of the end;

units.leftText: therefore, as I live,” says the Lord GOD, “I will prepare you for blood, and blood will pursue you. Since you have not hated blood, therefore blood will pursue you.
units.rightText: therefore, as I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, I will prepare thee unto blood, and blood shall pursue thee: since thou hast not hated blood, therefore blood shall pursue thee.

units.leftText: Thus I will make Mount Seir an astonishment and a desolation. I will cut off from it him who passes through and him who returns.
units.rightText: Thus will I make mount Seir an astonishment and a desolation; and I will cut off from it him that passeth through and him that returneth.

units.leftText: I will fill its mountains with its slain. The slain with the sword will fall in your hills and in your valleys and in all your watercourses.
units.rightText: And I will fill its mountains with its slain: in thy hills and in thy valleys and in all thy watercourses shall they fall that are slain with the sword.

units.leftText: I will make you a perpetual desolation, and your cities will not be inhabited. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
units.rightText: I will make thee a perpetual desolation, and thy cities shall not be inhabited; and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: “‘“Because you have said, ‘These two nations and these two countries will be mine, and we will possess it,’ although the LORD was there,
units.rightText: Because thou hast said, These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess it; whereas Jehovah was there:

units.leftText: therefore, as I live,” says the Lord GOD, “I will do according to your anger, and according to your envy which you have shown out of your hatred against them; and I will make myself known among them when I judge you.
units.rightText: therefore, as I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, I will do according to thine anger, and according to thine envy which thou hast showed out of thy hatred against them; and I will make myself known among them, when I shall judge thee.

units.leftText: You will know that I, the LORD, have heard all your insults which you have spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, ‘They have been laid desolate. They have been given to us to devour.’
units.rightText: And thou shalt know that I, Jehovah, have heard all thy revilings which thou hast spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, They are laid desolate, they are given us to devour.

units.leftText: You have magnified yourselves against me with your mouth, and have multiplied your words against me. I have heard it.”
units.rightText: And ye have magnified yourselves against me with your mouth, and have multiplied your words against me: I have heard it.

units.leftText: The Lord GOD says: “When the whole earth rejoices, I will make you desolate.
units.rightText: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: When the whole earth rejoiceth, I will make thee desolate.

units.leftText: As you rejoiced over the inheritance of the house of Israel because it was desolate, so I will do to you. You will be desolate, Mount Seir, and all Edom, even all of it. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’”
units.rightText: As thou didst rejoice over the inheritance of the house of Israel, because it was desolate, so will I do unto thee: thou shalt be desolate, O mount Seir, and all Edom, even all of it; and they shall know that I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: You, son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel, and say, “You mountains of Israel, hear the LORD’s word.
units.rightText: And thou, son of man, prophesy unto the mountains of Israel, and say, Ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of Jehovah.

units.leftText: The Lord GOD says: ‘Because the enemy has said against you, “Aha!” and, “The ancient high places are ours in possession!”’
units.rightText: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because the enemy hath said against you, Aha! and, The ancient high places are ours in possession;

units.leftText: therefore prophesy, and say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Because, even because they have made you desolate, and swallowed you up on every side, that you might be a possession to the residue of the nations, and you are taken up in the lips of talkers, and the evil report of the people;”
units.rightText: therefore prophesy, and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because, even because they have made you desolate, and swallowed you up on every side, that ye might be a possession unto the residue of the nations, and ye are taken up in the lips of talkers, and the evil report of the people;

units.leftText: therefore, you mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD: The Lord GOD says to the mountains and to the hills, to the watercourses and to the valleys, to the desolate wastes and to the cities that are forsaken, which have become a prey and derision to the residue of the nations that are all around;
units.rightText: therefore, ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord Jehovah: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah to the mountains and to the hills, to the watercourses and to the valleys, to the desolate wastes and to the cities that are forsaken, which are become a prey and derision to the residue of the nations that are round about;

units.leftText: therefore the Lord GOD says: “Surely in the fire of my jealousy I have spoken against the residue of the nations, and against all Edom, that have appointed my land to themselves for a possession with the joy of all their heart, with despite of soul, to cast it out for a prey.”’
units.rightText: therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Surely in the fire of my jealousy have I spoken against the residue of the nations, and against all Edom, that have appointed my land unto themselves for a possession with the joy of all their heart, with despite of soul, to cast it out for a prey.

units.leftText: Therefore prophesy concerning the land of Israel, and tell the mountains, the hills, the watercourses and the valleys, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I have spoken in my jealousy and in my wrath, because you have borne the shame of the nations.”
units.rightText: Therefore prophesy concerning the land of Israel, and say unto the mountains and to the hills, to the watercourses and to the valleys, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I have spoken in my jealousy and in my wrath, because ye have borne the shame of the nations:

units.leftText: Therefore the Lord GOD says: “I have sworn, ‘Surely the nations that are around you will bear their shame.’
units.rightText: therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I have sworn, saying, Surely the nations that are round about you, they shall bear their shame.

units.leftText: “‘“But you, mountains of Israel, you shall shoot out your branches and yield your fruit to my people Israel; for they are at hand to come.
units.rightText: But ye, O mountains of Israel, ye shall shoot forth your branches, and yield your fruit to my people Israel; for they are at hand to come.

units.leftText: For, behold, I am for you, and I will come to you, and you will be tilled and sown.
units.rightText: For, behold, I am for you, and I will turn unto you, and ye shall be tilled and sown;

units.leftText: I will multiply men on you, all the house of Israel, even all of it. The cities will be inhabited and the waste places will be built.
units.rightText: and I will multiply men upon you, all the house of Israel, even all of it; and the cities shall be inhabited, and the waste places shall be builded;

units.leftText: I will multiply man and animal on you. They will increase and be fruitful. I will cause you to be inhabited as you were before, and you will do better than at your beginnings. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
units.rightText: and I will multiply upon you man and beast; and they shall increase and be fruitful; and I will cause you to be inhabited after your former estate, and will do better unto you than at your beginnings: and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: Yes, I will cause men to walk on you, even my people Israel. They will possess you, and you will be their inheritance, and you will never again bereave them of their children.”
units.rightText: Yea, I will cause men to walk upon you, even my people Israel; and they shall possess thee, and thou shalt be their inheritance, and thou shalt no more henceforth bereave them of children.

units.leftText: “‘The Lord GOD says: “Because they say to you, ‘You are a devourer of men, and have been a bereaver of your nation;’
units.rightText: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because they say unto you, Thou land art a devourer of men, and hast been a bereaver of thy nation;

units.leftText: therefore you shall devour men no more, and not bereave your nation any more,” says the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: therefore thou shalt devour men no more, neither bereave thy nation any more, saith the Lord Jehovah;

units.leftText: “I won’t let you hear the shame of the nations any more. You won’t bear the reproach of the peoples any more, and you won’t cause your nation to stumble any more,” says the Lord GOD.’”
units.rightText: neither will I let thee hear any more the shame of the nations, neither shalt thou bear the reproach of the peoples any more, neither shalt thou cause thy nation to stumble any more, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: Moreover the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, when the house of Israel lived in their own land, they defiled it by their ways and by their deeds. Their way before me was as the uncleanness of a woman in her impurity.
units.rightText: Son of man, when the house of Israel dwelt in their own land, they defiled it by their way and by their doings: their way before me was as the uncleanness of a woman in her impurity.

units.leftText: Therefore I poured out my wrath on them for the blood which they had poured out on the land, and because they had defiled it with their idols.
units.rightText: Wherefore I poured out my wrath upon them for the blood which they had poured out upon the land, and because they had defiled it with their idols;

units.leftText: I scattered them among the nations, and they were dispersed through the countries. I judged them according to their way and according to their deeds.
units.rightText: and I scattered them among the nations, and they were dispersed through the countries: according to their way and according to their doings I judged them.

units.leftText: When they came to the nations where they went, they profaned my holy name, in that men said of them, ‘These are the LORD’s people, and have left his land.’
units.rightText: And when they came unto the nations, whither they went, they profaned my holy name; in that men said of them, These are the people of Jehovah, and are gone forth out of his land.

units.leftText: But I had respect for my holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the nations where they went.
units.rightText: But I had regard for my holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the nations, whither they went.

units.leftText: “Therefore tell the house of Israel, ‘The Lord GOD says: “I don’t do this for your sake, house of Israel, but for my holy name, which you have profaned among the nations where you went.
units.rightText: Therefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I do not this for your sake, O house of Israel, but for my holy name, which ye have profaned among the nations, whither ye went.

units.leftText: I will sanctify my great name, which has been profaned among the nations, which you have profaned among them. Then the nations will know that I am the LORD,” says the Lord GOD, “when I am proven holy in you before their eyes.
units.rightText: And I will sanctify my great name, which hath been profaned among the nations, which ye have profaned in the midst of them; and the nations shall know that I am Jehovah, saith the Lord Jehovah, when I shall be sanctified in you before their eyes.

units.leftText: “‘“For I will take you from among the nations and gather you out of all the countries, and will bring you into your own land.
units.rightText: For I will take you from among the nations, and gather you out of all the countries, and will bring you into your own land.

units.leftText: I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean. I will cleanse you from all your filthiness and from all your idols.
units.rightText: And I will sprinkle clean water upon you, and ye shall be clean: from all your filthiness, and from all your idols, will I cleanse you.

units.leftText: I will also give you a new heart, and I will put a new spirit within you. I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you a heart of flesh.
units.rightText: A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you; and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you a heart of flesh.

units.leftText: I will put my Spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes. You will keep my ordinances and do them.
units.rightText: And I will put my Spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes, and ye shall keep mine ordinances, and do them.

units.leftText: You will dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers. You will be my people, and I will be your God.
units.rightText: And ye shall dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers; and ye shall be my people, and I will be your God.

units.leftText: I will save you from all your uncleanness. I will call for the grain and will multiply it, and lay no famine on you.
units.rightText: And I will save you from all your uncleannesses: and I will call for the grain, and will multiply it, and lay no famine upon you.

units.leftText: I will multiply the fruit of the tree and the increase of the field, that you may receive no more the reproach of famine among the nations.
units.rightText: And I will multiply the fruit of the tree, and the increase of the field, that ye may receive no more the reproach of famine among the nations.

units.leftText: “‘“Then you will remember your evil ways, and your deeds that were not good; and you will loathe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations.
units.rightText: Then shall ye remember your evil ways, and your doings that were not good; and ye shall loathe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations.

units.leftText: I don’t do this for your sake,” says the Lord GOD. “Let it be known to you. Be ashamed and confounded for your ways, house of Israel.”
units.rightText: Nor for your sake do I this, saith the Lord Jehovah, be it known unto you: be ashamed and confounded for your ways, O house of Israel.

units.leftText: “‘The Lord GOD says: “In the day that I cleanse you from all your iniquities, I will cause the cities to be inhabited and the waste places will be built.
units.rightText: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: In the day that I cleanse you from all your iniquities, I will cause the cities to be inhabited, and the waste places shall be builded.

units.leftText: The land that was desolate will be tilled instead of being a desolation in the sight of all who passed by.
units.rightText: And the land that was desolate shall be tilled, whereas it was a desolation in the sight of all that passed by.

units.leftText: They will say, ‘This land that was desolate has become like the garden of Eden. The waste, desolate, and ruined cities are fortified and inhabited.’
units.rightText: And they shall say, This land that was desolate is become like the garden of Eden; and the waste and desolate and ruined cities are fortified and inhabited.

units.leftText: Then the nations that are left around you will know that I, the LORD, have built the ruined places and planted that which was desolate. I, the LORD, have spoken it, and I will do it.”
units.rightText: Then the nations that are left round about you shall know that I, Jehovah, have builded the ruined places, and planted that which was desolate: I, Jehovah, have spoken it, and I will do it.

units.leftText: “‘The Lord GOD says: “For this, moreover, I will be inquired of by the house of Israel, to do it for them: I will increase them with men like a flock.
units.rightText: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: For this, moreover, will I be inquired of by the house of Israel, to do it for them: I will increase them with men like a flock.

units.leftText: As the flock for sacrifice, as the flock of Jerusalem in her appointed feasts, so the waste cities will be filled with flocks of men. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’”
units.rightText: As the flock for sacrifice, as the flock of Jerusalem in her appointed feasts, so shall the waste cities be filled with flocks of men; and they shall know that I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: The LORD’s hand was on me, and he brought me out in the LORD’s Spirit, and set me down in the middle of the valley; and it was full of bones.
units.rightText: The hand of Jehovah was upon me, and he brought me out in the Spirit of Jehovah, and set me down in the midst of the valley; and it was full of bones.

units.leftText: He caused me to pass by them all around; and behold, there were very many in the open valley, and behold, they were very dry.
units.rightText: And he caused me to pass by them round about: and, behold, there were very many in the open valley; and, lo, they were very dry.

units.leftText: He said to me, “Son of man, can these bones live?”
units.rightText: And he said unto me, Son of man, can these bones live? And I answered, O Lord Jehovah, thou knowest.

units.leftText: Again he said to me, “Prophesy over these bones, and tell them, ‘You dry bones, hear the LORD’s word.
units.rightText: Again he said unto me, Prophesy over these bones, and say unto them, O ye dry bones, hear the word of Jehovah.

units.leftText: The Lord GOD says to these bones: “Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and you will live.
units.rightText: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah unto these bones: Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and ye shall live.

units.leftText: I will lay sinews on you, and will bring up flesh on you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and you will live. Then you will know that I am the LORD.”’”
units.rightText: And I will lay sinews upon you, and will bring up flesh upon you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and ye shall live; and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: So I prophesied as I was commanded. As I prophesied, there was a noise, and behold, there was an earthquake. Then the bones came together, bone to its bone.
units.rightText: So I prophesied as I was commanded: and as I prophesied, there was a noise, and, behold, an earthquake; and the bones came together, bone to its bone.

units.leftText: I saw, and, behold, there were sinews on them, and flesh came up, and skin covered them above; but there was no breath in them.
units.rightText: And I beheld, and, lo, there were sinews upon them, and flesh came up, and skin covered them above; but there was no breath in them.

units.leftText: Then he said to me, “Prophesy to the wind, prophesy, son of man, and tell the wind, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Come from the four winds, breath, and breathe on these slain, that they may live.”’”
units.rightText: Then said he unto me, Prophesy unto the wind, prophesy, son of man, and say to the wind, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Come from the four winds, O breath, and breathe upon these slain, that they may live.

units.leftText: So I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up on their feet, an exceedingly great army.
units.rightText: So I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up upon their feet, an exceeding great army.

units.leftText: Then he said to me, “Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel. Behold, they say, ‘Our bones are dried up, and our hope is lost. We are completely cut off.’
units.rightText: Then he said unto me, Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel: behold, they say, Our bones are dried up, and our hope is lost; we are clean cut off.

units.leftText: Therefore prophesy, and tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, my people; and I will bring you into the land of Israel.
units.rightText: Therefore prophesy, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, O my people; and I will bring you into the land of Israel.

units.leftText: You will know that I am the LORD, when I have opened your graves and caused you to come up out of your graves, my people.
units.rightText: And ye shall know that I am Jehovah, when I have opened your graves, and caused you to come up out of your graves, O my people.

units.leftText: I will put my Spirit in you, and you will live. Then I will place you in your own land; and you will know that I, the LORD, have spoken it and performed it,” says the LORD.’”
units.rightText: And I will put my Spirit in you, and ye shall live, and I will place you in your own land: and ye shall know that I, Jehovah, have spoken it and performed it, saith Jehovah.

units.leftText: The LORD’s word came again to me, saying,
units.rightText: The word of Jehovah came again unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “You, son of man, take one stick and write on it, ‘For Judah, and for the children of Israel his companions.’ Then take another stick, and write on it, ‘For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and for all the house of Israel his companions.’
units.rightText: And thou, son of man, take thee one stick, and write upon it, For Judah, and for the children of Israel his companions: then take another stick, and write upon it, For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and for all the house of Israel his companions:

units.leftText: Then join them for yourself to one another into one stick, that they may become one in your hand.
units.rightText: and join them for thee one to another into one stick, that they may become one in thy hand.

units.leftText: “When the children of your people speak to you, saying, ‘Won’t you show us what you mean by these?’
units.rightText: And when the children of thy people shall speak unto thee, saying, Wilt thou not show us what thou meanest by these?

units.leftText: tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel his companions; and I will put them with it, with the stick of Judah, and make them one stick, and they will be one in my hand.
units.rightText: say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel his companions; and I will put them with it, even with the stick of Judah, and make them one stick, and they shall be one in my hand.

units.leftText: The sticks on which you write will be in your hand before their eyes.”’
units.rightText: And the sticks whereon thou writest shall be in thy hand before their eyes.

units.leftText: Say to them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I will take the children of Israel from among the nations where they have gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land.
units.rightText: And say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will take the children of Israel from among the nations, whither they are gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land:

units.leftText: I will make them one nation in the land, on the mountains of Israel. One king will be king to them all. They will no longer be two nations. They won’t be divided into two kingdoms any more at all.
units.rightText: and I will make them one nation in the land, upon the mountains of Israel; and one king shall be king to them all; and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all;

units.leftText: They won’t defile themselves any more with their idols, nor with their detestable things, nor with any of their transgressions; but I will save them out of all their dwelling places in which they have sinned, and will cleanse them. So they will be my people, and I will be their God.
units.rightText: neither shall they defile themselves any more with their idols, nor with their detestable things, nor with any of their transgressions; but I will save them out of all their dwelling-places, wherein they have sinned, and will cleanse them: so shall they be my people, and I will be their God.

units.leftText: “‘“My servant David will be king over them. They all will have one shepherd. They will also walk in my ordinances and observe my statutes, and do them.
units.rightText: And my servant David shall be king over them; and they all shall have one shepherd: they shall also walk in mine ordinances, and observe my statutes, and do them.

units.leftText: They will dwell in the land that I have given to Jacob my servant, in which your fathers lived. They will dwell therein, they, and their children, and their children’s children, forever. David my servant will be their prince forever.
units.rightText: And they shall dwell in the land that I have given unto Jacob my servant, wherein your fathers dwelt; and they shall dwell therein, they, and their children, and their children’s children, for ever: and David my servant shall be their prince for ever.

units.leftText: Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them. It will be an everlasting covenant with them. I will place them, multiply them, and will set my sanctuary among them forever more.
units.rightText: Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them; it shall be an everlasting covenant with them; and I will place them, and multiply them, and will set my sanctuary in the midst of them for evermore.

units.leftText: My tent also will be with them. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
units.rightText: My tabernacle also shall be with them; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.

units.leftText: The nations will know that I am the LORD who sanctifies Israel, when my sanctuary is among them forever more.”’”
units.rightText: And the nations shall know that I am Jehovah that sanctifieth Israel, when my sanctuary shall be in the midst of them for evermore.

units.leftText: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, set your face toward Gog, of the land of Magog, the prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal, and prophesy against him,
units.rightText: Son of man, set thy face toward Gog, of the land of Magog, the prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal, and prophesy against him,

units.leftText: and say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I am against you, Gog, prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal.
units.rightText: and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I am against thee, O Gog, prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal:

units.leftText: I will turn you around, and put hooks into your jaws, and I will bring you out, with all your army, horses and horsemen, all of them clothed in full armor, a great company with buckler and shield, all of them handling swords;
units.rightText: and I will turn thee about, and put hooks into thy jaws, and I will bring thee forth, and all thine army, horses and horsemen, all of them clothed in full armor, a great company with buckler and shield, all of them handling swords:

units.leftText: Persia, Cush, and Put with them, all of them with shield and helmet;
units.rightText: Persia, Cush, and Put with them, all of them with shield and helmet;

units.leftText: Gomer, and all his hordes; the house of Togarmah in the uttermost parts of the north, and all his hordes—even many peoples with you.
units.rightText: Gomer, and all his hordes; the house of Togarmah in the uttermost parts of the north, and all his hordes; even many peoples with thee.

units.leftText: “‘“Be prepared, yes, prepare yourself, you, and all your companies who are assembled to you, and be a guard to them.
units.rightText: Be thou prepared, yea, prepare thyself, thou, and all thy companies that are assembled unto thee, and be thou a guard unto them.

units.leftText: After many days you will be visited. In the latter years you will come into the land that is brought back from the sword, that is gathered out of many peoples, on the mountains of Israel, which have been a continual waste; but it is brought out of the peoples and they will dwell securely, all of them.
units.rightText: After many days thou shalt be visited: in the latter years thou shalt come into the land that is brought back from the sword, that is gathered out of many peoples, upon the mountains of Israel, which have been a continual waste; but it is brought forth out of the peoples, and they shall dwell securely, all of them.

units.leftText: You will ascend. You will come like a storm. You will be like a cloud to cover the land, you and all your hordes, and many peoples with you.”
units.rightText: And thou shalt ascend, thou shalt come like a storm, thou shalt be like a cloud to cover the land, thou, and all thy hordes, and many peoples with thee.

units.leftText: “‘The Lord GOD says: “It will happen in that day that things will come into your mind, and you will devise an evil plan.
units.rightText: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: It shall come to pass in that day, that things shall come into thy mind, and thou shalt devise an evil device:

units.leftText: You will say, ‘I will go up to the land of unwalled villages. I will go to those who are at rest, who dwell securely, all of them dwelling without walls, and having neither bars nor gates,
units.rightText: and thou shalt say, I will go up to the land of unwalled villages; I will go to them that are at rest, that dwell securely, all of them dwelling without walls, and having neither bars nor gates;

units.leftText: to take the plunder and to take prey; to turn your hand against the waste places that are inhabited, and against the people who are gathered out of the nations, who have gotten livestock and goods, who dwell in the middle of the earth.’
units.rightText: to take the spoil and to take the prey; to turn thy hand against the waste places that are now inhabited, and against the people that are gathered out of the nations, that have gotten cattle and goods, that dwell in the middle of the earth.

units.leftText: Sheba, Dedan, and the merchants of Tarshish, with all its young lions, will ask you, ‘Have you come to take the plunder? Have you assembled your company to take the prey, to carry away silver and gold, to take away livestock and goods, to take great plunder?’”’
units.rightText: Sheba, and Dedan, and the merchants of Tarshish, with all the young lions thereof, shall say unto thee, Art thou come to take the spoil? hast thou assembled thy company to take the prey? to carry away silver and gold, to take away cattle and goods, to take great spoil?

units.leftText: “Therefore, son of man, prophesy, and tell Gog, ‘The Lord GOD says: “In that day when my people Israel dwells securely, will you not know it?
